Few supplements are as foundational as Omega-3. Omega-3 fatty acids are considered essential because your body cannot produce them on its own, you have to get them from food or supplements. At the cellular level, they are vital building blocks, supporting the structure of cell membranes and fueling key signaling pathways that influence everything from energy production to immune support. 

The three most important omega-3 fatty acids are: 

  • ALA (alpha-linolenic acid)
  • EPA (eicosapentaenoic acid)
  • DHA (docosahexaenoic acid)

ALA is found mainly in plant sources, whereas EPA and DHA are abundant in marine sources like fish. ALA has its benefits, but it must be converted into EPA and DHA in the body, an inefficient process, so supplementing with high-quality EPA or DHA is usually better.

Omega-3 Benefits for Brain, Heart, and Joint Health

If you are considering adding an omega-3 supplement to your routine, you’re probably asking: what benefits will I actually feel? Research shows that omega-3 fatty acids touch on many aspects of health, most notably the brain, the heart, and the joints. 


Brain Health

Omega-3s, particularly DHA, are integral to brain cell membranes. They’ve been shown to support cognition, memory, mood balance, and mental clarity. Whether you are looking to stay sharp, support long-term cognitive function, omega-3s are a proven ally.


Heart Health

If you’ve ever wondered whether omega-3 supplements can impact heart health, the answer is encouraging. Heart health is one of the best-studied areas of omega-3 research. EPA and DHA support healthy circulation and blood flow, and help support healthy cholesterol and triglyceride levels. Together, these benefits contribute to long-term cardiovascular support.  


Joint Support

From staying in shape to keeping up with your kids, mobility matters. Omega-3 fatty acids play a role in joint comfort, flexibility, and easing discomfort after activity or exercise by helping support natural inflammatory processes. This makes them a valuable tool for anyone who wants to keep moving with ease.

title: The Link Between Synthetic Caffeine and the "Crash"
description: Feeling burned out? Learn how synthetic energy impacts your health and discover a natural, long-term energy solution.
author: Three
html:
If you, like millions of others, rely on caffeine to get you through the day, but still feel tired or anxious, you’re not alone. 

While caffeine delivers a quick energy boost, it can also put long-term strain on your body’s natural systems, especially when consumed in synthetic forms or excessive amounts. 

The effect? Feeling like you’re running on empty. 

Your problem isn’t burnout, it’s biochemical. More caffeine isn’t the solution; better caffeine is. 

In this article, we’ll explore why synthetic caffeine can cause your energy to crash instead of climb, and introduce a smarter,  alternative. 

The Hidden Cost of Synthetic Caffeine on Long-Term Energy 

Most of us think of caffeine as a harmless pick-me-up and don’t understand what it’s really doing to our bodies. 

Synthetic caffeine overstimulates the adrenal glands and triggers the release of stress hormones (cortisol and adrenaline). This activates the body's stress-response pathways, giving you a temporary surge in focus and alertness with a crash that comes later. 

This quick-energy hit creates something known as energy debt: these short bursts of energy followed by crashes leave you more drained than before, leaving you with a need for more stimulation, repeating the cycle. 

You end up more depleted, more dependent, and more out of balance. This out-of-balance state is often referred to as “energy debt”, a term used to describe a cycle in which temporary stimulation is followed by an equal and just as dramatic decline in energy. 

Caffeine works in two ways–it blocks adenosine, a neurotransmitter that promotes feelings of tiredness, while at the same time stimulating the release of stress hormones such as cortisol and adrenaline. When caffeine wears off, adenosine signaling returns, and many people experience caffeine crash symptoms such as fatigue, irritability, difficulty concentrating, and increased cravings for another jolt of caffeine. And the cycle repeats itself. The risk is that, over time, relying on repeated artificial stimulation may contribute to energy fluctuations, sleep disruption, and a feeling of being constantly “wired or tired.” 

Instead, choose to support the body’s natural energy systems. This is a better, more sustainable way to generate reliable energy throughout the day. 

Is it Time for a Synthetic Caffeine Detox?

If you’re experiencing any of the following, your body may be signaling to you that it’s time for a reset:

  • You need multiple energy drinks just to feel “normal”.
  • You feel wired but still tired: unable to relax but too fatigued to focus. 
  • You get poor sleep or crash hard mid-day. 
  • You feel foggy, moody, or irritable without caffeine. 

Sound familiar? You might be stuck in a loop of caffeine dependency that’s wearing you down and interfering with your ability to regulate long-term energy naturally. A caffeine detox, or at minimum, a shift to cleaner sources, may be exactly what your body needs. 

If you’re considering a caffeine detox or looking to reduce caffeine intake, it’s important to know that some temporary withdrawal symptoms are common. As the body adjusts, you may experience headaches, fatigue, irritability, and difficulty concentrating, or increased sleepiness for a few days to a week. While these symptoms can be uncomfortable, they reflect your body’s honest efforts to transition away from dependency on stimulants like caffeine and toward reestablishing more natural energy regulation. 

Natural Alternatives for Sustainable Energy and Adrenal Support

Natural stimulant alternatives are substances that boost energy without triggering the adrenal glands. These include adaptogens, nootropics, and natural energy compounds that help the body adapt to stress rather than trigger it. They support your energy systems at the cellular level, helping you feel focused, awake, and resilient, without the crash that synthetic caffeine brings. 

Some of the most effective options for natural energy boosters and burnout recovery include:

  • Yerba Santa: Supports focus and vitality without spiking cortisol
  • Rhodiola: Boosts endurance and stress resilience
  • L-Theanine: Promotes calm focus without drowsiness
  • Glycine: Supports cognitive function
  • Rosavins: Lifts mood and helps the body adapt to stress
  • Ginsenosides: Compounds that support brain function and memory
  • Natural caffeine: If you do find yourself needing that caffeine fix, natural plant-based caffeine delivers jitter-free energy to your body and mind without the crash. *

Beyond supplementation, there are simple lifestyle shifts you can make to help restore long-term energy:

  • Prioritize hydration: dehydration can often be confused with fatigue 
  • Eat nutrient-rich foods that support your metabolism
  • Get enough sleep
  • Manage stress through movement, breathwork, or meditation

The Clean Energy Drink You’ve Been Waiting For

Enter: Kynetik 

Kynetik is a modern energy solution for clean, balanced performance. Unlike traditional options that rely on synthetic caffeine and sugar to spike your nervous system, Kynetik energy acts at the cellular level to provide stable, long-lasting energy. title: 3 Reasons to Kick Off Your Next Good Habit Now
description: Discover three effective strategies to kickstart and sustain new habits for improved wellness, confidence, and energy, making healthy changes easy and fun.
author: THREE Team
html:
Starting something new can be a little scary (maybe a little anxiety-inducing, even), but small steps can make it simple.

And whether it’s a little tweak to your routine or a big lifestyle shift, now is the perfect time to take the leap! 

Here’s why (and how) to make it stick.

1️⃣ Fresh Starts for Creativity and Daily Wellness

A fresh start isn’t just for Monday mornings (or back-to-school), it’s for any moment you decide to hit “reset!” Small, mindful habits can have a big impact on your energy, focus, and overall wellness.

Try this:

  • Take a 5-minute stretch or gentle movement each morning. It wakes up your body and your brain!

  • Add a mini mindful moment, close your eyes, focus on your breath, or jot down one thing you’re grateful for.

✨ Pro tip: Pair your mindful moment with a serving of Imúne for an extra boost to support your immune system and wellness while you set your intentions for the day.

Other easy ideas:

  • Swap one sugary drink for water first thing in the morning, or simply make water the first thing you consume.

  • Listen to a short inspiring podcast while making breakfast.

Small, intentional steps like these are your ticket to building habits that stick, and starting fresh has never been as simple as it is today!

2️⃣ Better Habits for Confidence and Skincare Glow

Better habits aren’t just about productivity, they’re about feeling good in your own skin. Focusing on self-care routines that are quick, effective, and consistent can make a noticeable difference.

Try this:

  • Create a minimalist skincare routine: cleanse, tone, and apply a serum. Quick, simple, effective.

  • Take one small daily action that boosts confidence, like making your bed, writing a to-do list, or taking a short walk outside.

✨ Pro tip: Make your skincare ritual effortless with Visage Super Serum. Just a few drops in your routine can leave your skin feeling nourished and radiant, so even the busiest mornings can feel luxurious.

Other easy wins:

  • Keep a bottle of water nearby and sip consistently throughout the day.

  • Take a 10-minute stretch break at your desk to refresh your body and mind.

Better habits = better confidence. It’s that simple!

3️⃣ Habit Stacking Tips for Energy, Focus, and Health

Habit stacking is the secret to making new habits effortless. By pairing a new habit with something you already do, it becomes part of your daily rhythm, no extra mental energy required.

Try this:

title: 3 Refreshing Cherry Kynetik Drinks You’ll Want to Sip All the Time
description: Discover three refreshing Cherry Rush-flavored Kynetik drink recipes to elevate your energy boost, featuring Cherry Ginger Spritz, Frozen Cherry Mojito Mocktail, and Cherry Lime Pop.
author: Three
html:
Looking for new ways to enjoy your Cherry Rush-flavored Kynetik? Whether you’re cooling down after a busy day, mixing things up for a weekend get-together, or just craving something fresh and fun, we’ve got you covered. These three simple recipes transform your go-to energy boost into something extra special.

Cherry Ginger Spritz

A bubbly, slightly spicy refresher that balances sweet cherry with the zing of ginger.

Ingredients

  • 1 packet Cherry Rush Kynetik

  • ½ cup (4 oz) cold water

  • ½ cup (4 oz) ginger beer

  • ¼ cup fresh smashed cherries

  • Ice to serve

Instructions

  1. In a glass, stir together Cherry Rush Kynetik and cold water until dissolved.

  2. Add ginger beer and gently mix.

  3. Stir in fresh smashed cherries.

  4. Fill with ice, give it one last stir, and enjoy your spritz!

Frozen Cherry Mojito Mocktail

A mocktail that feels like a vacation, cool, minty, and bright with lime.

Ingredients

  • 1 packet Cherry Rush Kynetik

  • ½ cup cold water

  • ½ cup soda water

  • Juice of ½ lime

  • Handful of mint leaves

  • Ice and cherries for garnish

Instructions

  1. Add Cherry Rush Kynetik, cold water, lime juice, and mint leaves to a blender with ice.

  2. Blend until slushy and smooth.

  3. Pour into a glass, top with soda water, and give it a quick stir.

  4. Garnish with extra cherries and mint. Sip and pretend you’re poolside.

Cherry Lime Pop

Simple, tangy, and naturally sweetened, perfect for an afternoon pick-me-up.

Ingredients

  • 1 packet Cherry Rush Kynetik

  • 8 oz cold water

  • 1 oz fresh lime juice (about 1 lime)

  • 1 tsp agave or honey

  • Lime slice and ice to garnish

Instructions

  1. Mix Cherry Rush Kynetik with cold water until fully dissolved.

  2. Add fresh lime juice and agave (or honey). Stir well.

  3. Pour over ice and garnish with a lime slice for that extra pop.

What Real Energy Should Look Like

A natural energy drink should provide clean, sustained energy by combining natural sources of caffeine with nutrients that work at the cellular level to support focus, fight fatigue, and boost cognition. It works with your body’s own energy system, not against it. Conventional energy drinks rely on synthetic stimulation, caffeine produced in a lab from chemicals rather than from natural sources. Natural caffeine is derived directly from plants and tends to be absorbed more gradually by the body, often alongside other naturally occurring compounds that support a smoother energy experience. Electrolytes and B vitamins play an equally supportive role. Electrolytes (such as sodium, potassium, and magnesium) help maintain fluid balance and cellular communication, which are essential for sustained physical and mental energy throughout the day. B vitamins, meanwhile, help the body maintain the nutrient levels needed to support energy metabolism, mental performance, and overall vitality. Together, these ingredients help Kynetik deliver on the promise of real, balanced energy.

Most so-called “natural” energy drink alternatives fall short because they aren’t all that natural. title: What Makes a Moisturizer Luxurious? How Visage Crème Caviar Uplevels Skincare
description: Are luxury moisturizers worth the price you pay? Find out as we explore the benefits of high-end skincare.
author: Three
html:
Have you ever wondered why some face creams cost more than others? Does your skin really reap the benefits of a pricier cream, or will the drugstore brand do the trick? The answer may surprise you. While skincare has become synonymous with self-care, a quality moisturizer is about more than a pleasant fragrance and nice packaging. A luxury moisturizer can truly be more effective than a drugstore brand, but even still, not all luxury moisturizers are worth the hype.

What Makes a Moisturizer Luxurious?

There are several factors that make a moisturizer luxurious. If you’re considering taking the leap into luxury moisturizing creams, here are a few of the reasons why you should.

Texture, Fragrance, and Packaging

While texture, fragrance, and packaging don’t contribute to the effectiveness of a luxury moisturizer, they do improve the overall experience of using it. Still, these things alone don’t justify paying more for a hydrating face cream for dry skin.

Quality Ingredients

Luxury moisturizers are made with higher quality ingredients and fewer chemicals and fillers. This is especially important in skincare, where the product is being absorbed directly into your body. Better ingredients are also more effective and produce better results than their low-quality counterparts. You can also get a broader range of active ingredients, which means your moisturizer will provide more broad support to the skin.

Clinically Backed

High-quality moisturizers are more likely to be clinically backed. That means they are developed by skincare professionals and have undergone rigorous testing, including clinical trials performed on humans. This scientific stamp of approval validates their claims and ensures they do what they say they will.

Long-Term Skin Benefits

Some skincare products deliver only temporary effects.  A luxury moisturizer is often formulated with higher-quality ingredients that support long-term improvements in your skin's appearance, helping you to maintain a smoother, more radiant look over time.

Cellular-Level Performance

Remember that texture we talked about earlier? Well, it doesn’t just make the moisturizer feel good, it can actually make it more effective too. The more refined ingredients can be absorbed into the skin easily, giving them the ability to support the skin at a cellular level, and not just a topical one.

In order to make drugstore skincare affordable to the masses, it is developed with readily available ingredients and a focus on mass production. On the other hand, high-end skincare products use better ingredients. These are more effective and are specially chosen to address specific skincare needs.

One example of higher-quality ingredients is peptides in skincare. Peptides are added to skincare products to support to the skin's natural barrier against harmful environmental factors and to support the body's natural production of collagen and elastin.They are commonly featured in moisturizers designed to target signs of aging, as they support the appearance of youthful, more resilient skin.  

A newer trend in skincare is healthy aging moisturizers with neurocosmetic ingredients. Just like peptides, neurocosmetic ingredients are designed to work from the inside out. They interact with the skin’s nervous system and support neurotransmitter activity. So they truly support the skin at a cellular level.

Some luxury moisturizer products contain specialty ingredients. For example, Visage Crème Caviar is a moisturizer made with Mountain Caviar extract, which is known for its rich nutrients and its ability to revitalize and restore the skin’s optimal appearance. Glyceryl glucoside is also beneficial in a skincare product because of its hydration properties. You’ll never find unique ingredients such as these in standard skincare products.

It’s also important to note what you won’t find in a luxury moisturizer. 

The best ones don’t contain sulfates or parabens. These ingredients can cause skin irritations, allergic reactions, and are potential hormone disruptors. You should avoid any skincare products that contain these ingredients, as they are more commonly found in lower-quality products.

How to Use a Luxury Moisturizer for Maximum Results

These days, a skincare regimen is a form of self-care. But be that as it may, there’s still a limited number of hours in the day to dedicate to the upkeep of your skin. 

It’s important to keep it simple, which is where products that do more come into play. Luxury skincare routine steps don’t need to be overly complex because each product is designed to do more. In fact, a few simple steps are all you really need when you’re using the right products. We recommend:

title: 7 Signs You Need a Skincare Serum
description: Is it time you added a serum to your daily skincare routine? We’re talking all things skincare serums, including how to know if you need one and what to look for when choosing a serum.
author: Three
html:
The world of skincare can be intimidating. 

There are countless lotions, potions, and creams on the market, as well as skincare serums. And with so many options, how do you know which products to choose? Do you really need a serum? 

Don’t worry, we’re here to help you demystify the world of skincare! We’ll show you the benefits of using a face serum as part of your daily routine and recommend the best serums for wrinkles and fine lines.

7 Signs You Need a Skincare Serum

Curious about how to know if you need a serum for your face? Odds are, your skin is already telling you everything you need to know. Here are seven signs your skin needs a serum:

Dryness

If your skin is dry and you feel like lotion isn’t working anymore, a skincare serum may be what you need to provide hydration in a hurry. Serums can be more effective than lotions because they have higher concentrations of active ingredients. This, combined with the smaller molecule size of serums, makes it easier for your skin to absorb, which means it works faster and is more effective than a lotion or cream.

Uneven Tone

You can use a serum for dry skin AND uneven tone. Dry patches, uneven melanin production, dead skin buildup, and fine lines can all contribute to uneven skin tone. A skincare serum can help brighten the complexion and improve the appearance and texture of the skin, which in turn leads to a smoother, more even-looking tone.

Rough Texture

Rough texture of the skin can be caused by many factors, including dryness, fine lines and wrinkles, dead skin buildup, and clogged pores. Yikes! A skincare serum helps moisturize and exfoliate your face to provide a smoother-looking surface.

Wrinkles

Fine lines and wrinkles are a part of life, but that doesn’t mean you have to take them as they come, because another one of the benefits of using a face serum is its ability to smooth the appearance of wrinkles. Serums do this in several ways. First, they moisturize the skin, then they support collagen production, both of which help reduce the appearance of wrinkles.

Large Pores

Many factors, including genetics, sun damage, aging, makeup, excess oil production, and more, can contribute to large facial pores. 

While a skincare serum can’t change your genetics, it can unclog, exfoliate, and refine the look of your skin, as well as help manage oil production, which will leave your pores looking fine. (Literally.)

Dullness

Even if your skin isn’t particularly dry, it can still be dull.

Your skin is in a constant state of shedding, with a complete skin turnover happening every 28-30 days. Sometimes the body needs a little help getting rid of that old skin. Buildup of skin cells can cause your face to appear dull. A skincare serum can help exfoliate the dead skin and brighten up your new skin for a radiant look.

Dark Spots

Dark spots appear as a result of uneven melanin production. A facial serum can help reduce the appearance of existing dark spots and circles. 

How to Choose the Right Skincare Serum for Your Needs

Now that you know the importance of a skincare serum, how do you know which one to choose?

Here’s a hint: Not all skincare serums are created equal. There are a few benefits you should look for when selecting your next skincare serum.

Ingredient Transparency

A skincare company should be able to tell you what ingredients are in the product, where they came from, and how the product is produced. The people demand cleaner skincare products, and with good reason! Your body is absorbing your skincare serum, so make sure you know what’s in it and what it’s doing to (and for) your skin.

Clinical Backing

While science plays a part in most skincare development, not all skincare is clinically backed. Clinical backing means there is scientific research and evidence of effectiveness. A clinically backed product also tends to be deemed safer, and has usually undergone clinical trials with testing on humans. The studies help validate the products and attest to their benefits.

Neurocosmetics

There’s a link between the way you look and the way you feel. Neurocosmetics are strengthening that link. Neurocosmetic skincare contains bioactive ingredients that interact with the body’s nervous system to help you feel good from the inside out.

Ease of Use

Let’s face it, the more complicated your skincare routine gets, the less likely you are to stick with it. A skincare serum that helps simplify your daily routine is an added bonus!

Get The Best Skincare Serum

We love Visage Super Serum because it was developed by Dr. Dan, a Cal-tech trained PhD in organic chemistry, is made with clinically tested neurocosmetic ingredients, and delivers visible results with every use.

title: The Social Media Advantage: Grow Your THREE Business Online
description: Leverage social media to grow your business with actionable tips and strategies for creating engaging photo and video content. Get started and connect with your audience today.
author: Three
html:
In 2025, one thing is certain: if you’re not using social media to grow your business, you’re falling behind. 

At our recent THREE convention, we hosted a breakout all about how to use social media to build visibility, deepen trust, and ultimately increase your income. And if you’re feeling overwhelmed or “not a social media person,” don’t worry , this blog is your guide. 

Whether you’re just getting started or ready to take things to the next level, here’s how to build your brand online with clarity and confidence. 

Why Social Media Still Matters 

Let’s be clear: social media is free marketing. It’s where your customers already are, and it’s one of the fastest ways to build credibility. In today’s digital-first world, social media isn’t optional , it’s essential. 

“I don’t use social media” is like saying “I don’t use a phone” in 2025. If you have a product or business you believe in, this is the place to share it. 

What to Post: Photos vs Reels 

You’ve probably heard that video is king , and it’s true , but both photo content and video content have their place. Here’s how to know which to use: 

Photos & Graphics (aka Static Posts + Carousels) 

  • Quick to make when you’re short on time 
  • Perfect for educational tips or quotes 
  • Easy to batch ahead using templates 
  • Less pressure (you don’t have to show your face!) 
  • Great for clean product shots 

Reels 

  • Massive organic reach (Instagram favors video and pushes videos out to non-followers) 
  • Helps you build trust , people connect with you 
  • Lets you show how you use the product 
  • Works beautifully for storytelling 
  • Ideal for trending content 

Bottom line: Use both. Use photos to teach. Use video to connect. 

What Makes a Reel Actually Work? 

Every high-performing reel has four key ingredients: 

  1. Hook – Something that stops the scroll 
  1. Problem – A relatable pain point your audience feels 
  1. Solution – Not just the product, but what the product does 
  1. Call to Action – Tell them what to do next (save video, comment, DM) 

People don’t buy products. They buy solutions to their problems. 

Steal These Hooks (Yes, Really) 

If you ever feel stuck on what to say, use one of these proven openers: 

  • “Calling all ….” (identify a specific audience such as medical professionals, gym rats, health nuts, coaches, etc.) 
  • “Can I share a secret?” 
  • “Did you know ….”(share an interesting statistic) 
  • “How to …” 
  • “Fun fact: ….” (share a fun fact about the industry, an ingredient, a product etc.) 
  • “I wasn’t going to share this, but …” 
  • “The biggest lesson I’ve learned in my life.” 
  • “Do you only focus on …? Let me stop you right there. 
  • “Here’s how I know … is possible for you” 
  • “X Steps to …” 
  • “I can’t believe … but …” 
  • “Hate …? You are in luck.” 
  • “How I went from …” 
  • “You’ll never believe this.” 
  • Why I don’t …” 
  • If you want.... , read the caption below. 
Nervous About Being on Camera? 

Good news , you don’t have to show your face to create amazing content. 

Try this instead: 

  • Record a voiceover over a product shot 
  • Use a text-only reel with a powerful hook 
  • Film your hands unboxing or mixing your product 
  • Repost videos and graphics from the @three_international social media accounts! 

Start where you’re comfortable, but don’t stay stuck there forever. Growth happens when you stretch. 

The Simple Posting Plan 

You don’t need to be online all day. Try this weekly rhythm to stay consistent: 

  • 2 Reels 
  • 2 Stories 
  • 1 Static Post or Carousel 

Want to go all in? Follow the Weekly Go-Getter Plan: 

  • 5 Reels 
  • 10 Stories 
  • 2 Carousels 
You Don’t Need Perfect. You Just Need to Post. 

The most important step is to start. You already have everything you need , a story, a product, and a reason. 

Need a push? Find an accountability partner. Set a goal. Text someone on your team: “I’m posting this week. Hold me to it.” 

You’ve got this. Now, let's turn it into something actionable! 

 

Next Steps: 

  • Post your first reel 
  • Tag @three_international 

Let’s grow this thing , together.

title: What is Yerba Santa?

If you’ve been searching for a natural, caffeine-free energy alternative, you may have come across Yerba Santa. But what is Yerba Santa, and how does it support energy without caffeine?

This powerful botanical has been used holistically for generations. Traditionally used to support the lungs, this little-known plant is making a strong comeback–and for good reason. New formulas are harnessing its incredible power and positioning this underrated plant as a plant-based caffeine alternative to traditional synthetic energy drinks.

What Is Yerba Santa and Where Does It Come From?

Yerba Santa (eriodictyon californicum) is a fragrant evergreen shrub native to the southwestern regions of the United States. Primarily found in California, this shrub is rich in flavonoids like eriodictyol and resins that are rich in bioactive compounds that are known to support a healthy inflammatory response. Long known for its ability to support respiratory health, Indigenous tribes and early settlers used this “sacred herb” for various uses.

The yerba santa plant grows in dry, rocky slopes and habitats across California and parts of Oregon, Nevada, and Baja California. Eriodictyon californicum, its botanical name, belongs to the Namaceae family. Common names include “holy herb,” “mountain balm,” “bear’s weed,” and “consumption plant,” reflecting both its cultural history and the environment where it thrives. 

More recently, Yerba Santa has been recognized for its connection to energy support. 

Unlike Yerba Mate, which is a natural source of caffeine, Yerba Santa does not contain caffeine. However, specialty molecules found in the Yerba Santa plant support healthy adrenal function and the body’s stress response.

In other words, Yerba Santa helps support a more balanced energy release, keeping the dreaded caffeine crash at bay.

Energy Benefits of Yerba Santa

In addition to its traditional uses, Yerba Santa has a number of unique benefits that make it an intriguing addition to natural energy support. Yerba Santa also releases resin that is often rich with antioxidants, which may help support the body’s own inflammatory responses.

Recent research has identified a high concentration of sterubin, a neurosupportive flavonoid that helps support cognitive function and supports a healthy inflammatory response. Additionally, sterubin may contribute to balanced energy production at the cellular level.

Benefits of Yerba Santa include:

  • Natural energy support, without the caffeine
  • Cognitive and brain function support
  • Supports a healthy inflammatory response
  • Antioxidant support

Those drawn to adrenal support herbs and adaptogens may find yerba santa a compelling addition to a balanced wellness routine. As interest in stress-support herbs grows, yerba santa stands out as an antioxidant-rich herb that works in harmony with the body’s natural processes, not against them. Rather than forcing a stimulant response, it helps support the body’s own energy regulation pathways, making it a popular choice among those seeking gentler, more sustainable approaches to daily energy and vitality. 

See also: The Antioxidant Advantage: Simple Ways to Elevate Your Wellness

Yerba Santa vs. Synthetic Energy Sources: What's the Difference?

With their high concentration and rapid absorption, synthetic energy sources are often associated with negative effects such as jitters and crashes.

Unlike synthetic energy sources, Yerba Santa provides a clean alternative that helps support natural energy resulting in a more balanced energy release. 

This means more energy without the jitters, crashes, or synthetic chaos. In addition to the energy support that Yerba Santa offers, it is packed with other cellular benefits that go far beyond energy. These include antioxidant support, support of a healthy inflammatory response, and cognitive support. 

For those exploring clean energy drinks and natural energy drinks as alternatives to heavily caffeinated options, yerba santa offers a meaningful difference. Most conventional energy drinks rely on high-dose synthetic caffeine, artificial sweeteners, and added stimulants that can leave users feeling wired, then depleted. Botanical-based energy support, like that found in yerba santa, works differently. Rather than spiking and crashing, plant-based energy sources work with the body’s natural systems to help support a more even, sustainable level of vitality throughout the day. For anyone tired of the cycle of over-stimulation and burnout, clean energy drinks powered by ingredients like yerba santa represent a refreshing alternative.

Frequently Asked Questions About Yerba Santa

Curious about yerba santa? Whether you’re new to this botanical or looking to understand how it fits into your wellness routine, these frequently asked questions cover the essentials.

Does Yerba Santa Contain Caffeine?

No, yerba santa does not contain caffeine. Unlike yerba mate, which is a natural caffeine sources, Yerba santa is caffeine-free. Its energy-supporting properties come from specialty molecules that work with the body’s adrenal and stress-response systems, not from stimulants.

What Does Yerba Santa Taste Like?

Yerba santa has a distinctive flavor profile; mildly sweet and slightly resinous with herbal undertones. Its natural flavor can vary depending on how it’s prepared or formulated, and it blends well with other botanicals and flavors in modern energy drink formulations.

Is Yerba Santa Considered an Adaptogen?

Yerba santa shares some qualities with adaptogens, herbs traditionally valued for supporting the body to maintain balance during times of stress. While it is not always formally classified as an adaptogen, it is often grouped with adrenal support herbs and stress-support botanicals due to its ability to support the body’s stress-response systems and promote a sense of balanced energy.

How is Yerba Santa Traditionally Used?

Indigenous tribes across California and the southwestern U.S. have long used Yerba santa for a range of traditional purposes, most notably to support respiratory wellness. It was also used topically and consumed as a tea. Its nickname “holy herb” reflects the deep cultural reverence for its many practical uses over generations.

Why is Yerba Santa Used in Clean Energy Products?

Yerba santa is increasingly featured in natural energy drinks and clean energy formulations because it supports cellular energy production. Its antioxidant-rich profile, combined with its ability to support stress response and cognitive clarity, makes it a standout ingredient for those seeking a cleaner, more balanced approach to daily energy support.

title: 5 Benefits of Clean Caffeine Drinks

The million-dollar question everyone is asking is this: Do clean caffeine drinks really work? 

Our non-stop lifestyle requires energy! The Top 5 Benefits of Clean Caffeine Drinks

Many people are trying to balance their need for a quick hit of energy with a desire to be a bit more selective about the ingredients and additives in their drink of choice. People want caffeine drinks that offer more than just quick energy. 

Clean caffeine drinks prioritize simple, natural ingredients with other functional health benefits, energizing and nourishing at the same time. Here are the top 5 benefits of clean caffeine drinks.

Unlike conventional energy drinks, which often rely on high doses of synthetic caffeine, excessive sugar, and artificial additives to deliver fast but fleeting energy, clean energy drinks are built around natural caffeine sources and functional ingredients that work with the body’s own systems. This is the growing world of functional beverages: drinks designed not just to energize but also to support overall wellness. From electrolytes to adaptogens, the best natural caffeine sources do double duty, giving you the energy you need while also contributing to your broader health goals. 

Sustained Energy

Unlike the spike and crash you get with many energy drinks, clean caffeine sources offer a more gradual release of energy, helping you stay more energized throughout the day. Clean caffeine sources are primarily found in plants, distinguishing them from ones that are synthetic or chemically produced. 

Some of the most common sources of natural caffeine include coffee, tea, chocolate, and Yerba Maté.

When paired with specialty molecules like Yerba Santa, which helps the body resist adrenal fatigue, clean caffeine offers a smooth, sustained energy boost that leaves you feeling supported and energized.

Learn more about the benefits of Yerba Santa.

Cognitive Support

One of the benefits of using natural caffeine sources is the added functional benefits that come from whole ingredients. For example, in addition to caffeine, green tea leaves also contain L-theanine, an amino acid known for its calming and relaxing effects. 

Other ingredients, like glycine (an amino acid that plays a crucial role in nerve signal transmission) and rhodiola (an adaptogen that helps your system flex, not stress), support focus, clarity, and a positive mood state.

Hydration

Traditional energy drinks often lead to dehydration due to their high synthetic caffeine content, which acts as a diuretic, leading to fluid loss. Clean caffeine drinks often contain electrolytes to support hydration and fluid balance. This helps the body maintain cellular communication, which is crucial in keeping you energized throughout the day. 

Nutrient Support

Clean caffeine drinks often focus on replenishing vitamins and other nutrients that traditional energy drinks deplete. Added B vitamins can help maintain nutrient levels that may be impacted by daily stressors, while other natural ingredients can help support circulation, mental clarity, and other essential functions. 

Learn more: The Antioxidant Advantage: Simple Ways to Elevate Your Wellness

Healthy Rest

While synthetic caffeine sources can disrupt sleep, clean caffeine sources, ideally consumed earlier in the day, may have a less negative impact on sleep.

By energizing your body without keeping you wired, clean caffeine supports natural circadian rhythms so that you can still get the rest your body needs to support energy day after day. 

How to Choose the Best Clean Caffeine Drink

With the growing popularity of clean caffeine drinks, it can be a challenge to pick the best option for your needs. A good place to start is to read the label and choose a drink that contains simple, whole ingredients. Focus on options with natural, balanced caffeine sources. Look for other nutritional benefits, such as electrolytes and added vitamins, and avoid added sugars and other artificial ingredients. 

When evaluating the best clean energy drink for your needs, here’s a quick checklist of healthy energy drink ingredients to look for:

  • Natural caffeine sources (such as green tea, guarana, or green coffee bean) for smooth, sustained energy

  • Electrolytes to support hydration and cellular communication

  • B vitamins to help maintain nutrient levels that may be impacted by daily stressors

  • Adaptogens (like rhodiola) to help your system flex, not stress

  • Yerba Santa to support adrenal function and balanced energy

  • Neuro-supporting ingredients (like glycine) for focus and mental clarity


And here’s what to avoid:

  • Excessive sugar or high-fructose corn syrup, which can contribute to energy crashes

  • Artificial flavors, colors, or sweeteners

  • Proprietary blends that obscure what’s actually in your drink

  • Synthetic stimulants that deliver quick spikes at the cost of a longer crash

FAQ on Clean Caffeine Drinks

Have questions about clean caffeine drinks? You’re not alone. Here are answers to some of the most frequently asked questions about what clean caffeine is, how it works, and what to look for.

How is clean energy different from traditional energy drinks?

Traditional drinks are often loaded with sugar, synthetic stimulants, and artificial flavors that can lead to crashes and jitters. Clean caffeine delivers clean energy that is sourced from natural plants without all the chemical and sugary additives. It has healthier ingredients with no crash or jitters.

Are clean energy drinks healthier than traditional energy drinks?

Generally, yes. Because they use natural caffeine, less sugar, and fewer artificial ingredients, they do not lead to crashes or feeling low. Clean energy provides a more balanced energy.

Can clean energy drinks replace coffee?

They can. Clean energy drinks offer just as much focused energy with no side effects (crashes or spikes).

How much caffeine is in a clean caffeine drink?

It varies by brand and serving. Generally, most clean energy drinks contain 50-200 mg per serving–plenty to boost alertness without overloading your system.

How do I know how much caffeine is safe?

The daily recommended limits are under 400 mg for most adults, though you should consult with your physician about what may be safe for you and your individual needs.

Should I look at sugar content when choosing one?

Absolutely! Lower sugar means more stable and sustained energy. Many clean energy drinks use natural sweeteners or none at all.

Are there other ingredients I should pay attention to?

Look for natural adaptogens, electrolytes, or vitamins that support hydration, stress response, and mental clarity–these things complement caffeine rather than compete with it.

title: Easy Ways to Stay Active + Why a Natural Joint Recovery Supplement Matters
description: Stay active with easy daily movements and support joint recovery naturally with Revíve—an all-in-one post-workout supplement for flexibility and mobility.
author: Three
html:
Why Staying Active Supports Overall Wellness

Movement isn’t just for gym days, it’s a crucial part of daily wellness. Staying active helps maintain energy, flexibility, cardiovascular support, and even a positive mindset. Yet with busy schedules, it's easy for activity to fall to the bottom of the priority list.

The good news? You don't need a complicated fitness routine to make a real difference. Small, consistent movements throughout the day can promote mobility, support joint health, and keep your body feeling its best, even as you age.

Easy Ways to Stay Active for Better Joint Health and Mobility

Here are simple, practical ways to keep moving and support your joints, muscles, and overall well-being:

1. Stretch First Thing in the Morning

A quick 5-minute stretch wakes up your muscles, boosts circulation, and sets a positive tone for the day.

2. Take Short Walks Throughout the Day

Short walks, around the office, your neighborhood, or even your living room, help lubricate your joints and promote flexibility. Aim for a 5–10 minute walk every hour.

3. Choose the Stairs When Possible

Taking the stairs instead of the elevator strengthens your legs and supports your heart health, without requiring a big time commitment.

4. Desk-Friendly Moves for Busy Professionals

If you work at a desk, try seated leg lifts, shoulder shrugs, and calf raises. Even subtle movement encourages blood flow and can support healthy joints over time.

5. Turn Housework into a Workout

Vacuuming, gardening, and tidying up aren't just chores, they're opportunities to move. Make it fun by adding music or turning tasks into mini workouts.

6. End the Day with Gentle Evening Stretches

Evening stretches help release tension, improve range of motion, and prepare your body for better sleep.

Build a Daily Movement Routine That Fits Your Life

Consistency is key. Rather than squeezing in one long workout, try spreading movement throughout your day. Here’s a sample routine designed for real life:

🌅 Morning (5–10 minutes)

  • Wake-up Stretch Sequence: Reach overhead, roll your shoulders, twist your spine side to side.
  • Bodyweight Warm-Up: 10 air squats, 10 standing knee raises, 10 arm circles.
  • Optional Walk: A 10–15 minute walk outside or on a treadmill can jumpstart your metabolism.

Tip: Drink water and breathe deeply to support your body’s natural energy cycle.

🕛 Midday (10–15 minutes)

  • Desk Stretch Break: Every hour, stand up and move.
    • Arm and wrist stretches
    • Neck rolls and shoulder shrugs
    • Calf raises while brushing your teeth or waiting for coffee
  • Lunch Walk: If possible, take a brisk 10-minute walk after lunch to support digestion and circulation.
  • Mini Workout (Optional): 3 rounds of 10 squats, 10 modified push-ups (on wall or desk), 10-second planks

🌙 Evening (10 minutes or less)

  • Unwind With Movement: Try light yoga, a foam roller session, or guided mobility stretches.
  • TV Time Tricks: During commercials or streaming downtime, try seated leg lifts or hip circles.
  • Wind Down: Legs-up-the-wall pose or child’s pose can relax tired muscles and prep you for sleep.

Weekend Ideas for Movement and Mobility

Weekends can be a great time to reset your movement habits. Try one or two of the following:

  • Nature Walk or Hike
     Enjoy the mental and joint health benefits of moving outdoors.
  • Try a Mobility Flow Class
     Check YouTube for short mobility routines designed for joint health and range of motion.
  • Dance Around the House
     Yes, it counts. Put on music while cleaning and turn chores into cardio.
  • Active Errands
    Park farther away, take the stairs, or walk between stores when shopping.

Why Recovery Matters: The Missing Piece in Staying Active

Movement stresses your joints and muscles, in a good way. But without proper recovery, the body can feel stiff, tired, and less motivated to stay active.

That’s why active adults, busy professionals, and wellness-focused men and women over 35 are turning to a natural joint recovery supplement as part of their daily health routine. Supporting your body’s renewal process is just as important as the activity itself.

Revíve by THREE is specially designed for anyone who wants to keep moving comfortably and naturally. Whether you're squeezing in daily walks or powering through workouts, Revíve works at the cellular level (3X more bioavailable) to:

  • Support joint health and flexibility

  • Promote enhanced mobility and range of motion

  • Aid in muscle and joint recovery after exercise

  • Support daily movement and long-term joint comfort

This advanced, plant-based formula includes powerful ingredients like:

  • Turmeric Root Extract (Curcumin) – offers antioxidant support and joint comfort

  • Boswellia Serrata Extract – known to support mobility and flexibility

  • Black Cumin Oil and Grape Seed Extract (Resveratrol) – promote cellular function and circulation

  • Sea Buckthorn Oil – provides nourishing omega fatty acids

  • Ginger Root Oil, Shiitake Mushroom Extract, and Bioperine Black Pepper Extract – help enhance absorption and promote natural recovery

  • Peppermint Oil (Menthol) – for a refreshing and cooling support sensation

By choosing a holistic, plant-based supplement for workout recovery, you’re giving your body the tools it needs to stay flexible, mobile, and ready for anything.

The Bottom Line

Incorporating easy movement into your day doesn’t have to feel overwhelming. Small, intentional steps like stretching, short walks, and using your everyday tasks for physical activity can make a huge difference over time.

Pairing daily movement with Revíve by THREE, a natural joint support supplement, helps support the body’s natural renewal process, so you can continue doing what you love, every day.

What Should You Know Before Visiting Hong Kong?

Hong Kong is a bustling metropolis filled with rich history, modern architecture, and world-renowned cuisine. Whether you’re visiting for the first time or returning for another adventure, here’s what you need to know before your trip:

Travel Tips for First-Time Visitors

  1. Currency & Payments: Hong Kong uses the Hong Kong Dollar (HKD). Credit cards are widely accepted, but it’s always good to have some cash on hand for street markets and local shops.
  2. Language: While Cantonese is the primary language, English is widely spoken, especially in hotels, restaurants, and major attractions.
  3. Transportation: The MTR (subway) system is the fastest way to get around, and taxis are also readily available.
  4. Weather in March: Expect comfortable temperatures between 16°C-22°C (61°F-72°F), making it the perfect time for sightseeing.
  5. Packing Essentials: Bring comfortable walking shoes, a light jacket, and an umbrella, Hong Kong’s weather can change quickly!
  6. Cultural Etiquette: Tipping is not expected in restaurants, but it’s appreciated for excellent service. Also, avoid sticking chopsticks upright in rice, as it symbolizes bad luck in Chinese culture.

For more travel planning, check out the Hong Kong Tourism Board for helpful resources on attractions, transportation, and dining.

Why Hong Kong? A Destination Worth Exploring

Hong Kong is more than just a business hub, it’s a cultural and culinary paradise. Whether you love cityscapes, nature, or food, there’s something for everyone.

Must-See Attractions in Hong Kong

  • Victoria Peak – Ride the historic Peak Tram to enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the city skyline.
  • Temple Street Night Market – Experience Hong Kong’s vibrant street food scene, live entertainment, and local vendors.
  • Lantau Island & Big Buddha – Visit this iconic 112-foot statue, take a scenic cable car ride, and explore Po Lin Monastery.
  • Tsim Sha Tsui Promenade – Walk along the harbor and watch the city light up at night. Don’t miss the Symphony of Lights show!

Thinking about extending your stay? Hong Kong is the perfect gateway to explore more of Asia, consider a short trip to Macau, Thailand, or Japan after the convention!

This event is built for everyone, with live translations so you can fully enjoy leadership training, connect with top leaders from around the world, and grow your global business. title: The Antioxidant Advantage: Simple Ways to Elevate Your Wellness
description: Boost your wellness with antioxidants! Discover simple ways to add antioxidant-rich foods, teas, and supplements like Éternel to your daily routine for lasting vitality.
author: Three
html:
Antioxidants are more than just a buzzword, they are essential compounds that play a pivotal role in supporting your body’s natural defenses against oxidative stress. Recent research has helped us understand how pollution, UV exposure, and other factors of daily living cause oxidative stress in your body. This can increase the number of free radicals, which can impact and damage your cells. Fortunately, antioxidants are here to help. They are powerful allies that neutralize free radicals so your body can maintain balance and vitality. 

 But how can you naturally increase your antioxidant intake? The good news is that it doesn’t take a dramatic overhaul of your life, just a few intentional, practical changes to your routine can make all the difference. Let’s explore simple ways to enrich your body with antioxidants through nourishing foods, revitalizing beverages, and smart supplementation using antioxidant vitamins, minerals, and plant compounds. 

Understanding Oxidative Stress

Your body is constantly doing a balancing act to try and maintain a steady state. Free radicals are unstable oxygen molecules that are trying to disrupt the status quo and cause damage. And they would do just that if antioxidants didn’t step in to save the day. But let’s take a step back.

The production of free radicals is known as oxidative stress. There are a lot of things that can cause free radicals to form, including your body’s metabolism, UV exposure, poor diet, pollution, pesticides, aging, exercise recovery, and smoking. If your body has an excess of free radicals, they can damage your cells. What do antioxidants do? Antioxidants hunt down and stabilize free radicals to keep them from taking over. This restores balance and supports the health of your cells.

Fill Your Plate with Antioxidant-Rich Foods

Your diet is one of the most effective and accessible ways to increase your antioxidant intake. The key? Think colorful. Fruits and vegetables are rich in antioxidants like vitamins C and E, beta-carotene, and flavonoids, which all work to support your body’s natural balance.

Here’s a cheat sheet of vibrant, antioxidant-packed options:

  • Blueberries: These tiny berries are bursting with anthocyanins, a type of antioxidant that supports overall wellness.
  • Spinach and Kale: Leafy greens are loaded with vitamin C, beta-carotene, and other compounds that nourish your body.
  • Sweet Potatoes: Their bright orange hue signals a high beta-carotene content, which is excellent for supporting cellular processes.
  • Red Peppers: Packed with vitamin C, red peppers are a powerhouse addition to any meal.

Pro tip: Start your day with a smoothie that combines spinach, frozen açaí, and a splash of almond milk. Add in chia seeds for extra fiber and omega-3 fatty acids. This simple routine not only tastes amazing but also gives you a nutrient-packed jumpstart to your day.

Why Colorful Fruits and Vegetables Matter

Some of the best antioxidants are found in foods that are bright and colorful. Different colors represent different antioxidants like anthocyanins, lycopene, lutein, flavonoids, and carotenoids. This is why it’s important to eat the rainbow, since you get different antioxidant benefits from each.

Sip Your Way to Wellness

Antioxidants aren’t just in the foods we eat, they’re also in what we drink. One of the simplest ways to support your antioxidant intake is by choosing beverages that pack a punch.

  • Green Tea: Known for its catechins, green tea supports your body’s natural processes while offering a gentle energy boost. A warm cup in the morning or afternoon can work wonders.
  • Herbal Teas: Rooibos and hibiscus teas are great alternatives for those looking to diversify their tea collection. Both contain potent antioxidants and have a naturally soothing effect.
  • Dark Chocolate Drinks: If you’re looking for a decadent treat, consider a hot cocoa made with dark chocolate (at least 70% cocoa content). Dark chocolate contains flavonoids, which are antioxidants that support cellular well-being.

And if you’re a coffee lover, there’s good news, coffee contains a surprising number of antioxidants as well. However, as with anything, moderation is key.

Pro tip: Replace sugary sodas or energy drinks with iced green tea infused with lemon for an antioxidant boost that also keeps you hydrated and refreshed.

Even if you’re just drinking water, staying hydrated has the added benefit of supporting normal body processes and aiding cellular wellness, which can help antioxidants do their job. Healthy hydration includes drinking enough and avoiding excess sugar intake in your drinks. Establishing daily hydration habits is an important part of overall wellness.

The Healthy Aging Support of Éternel

While incorporating antioxidant-rich foods and beverages into your daily routine is essential, supplementing your efforts with antioxidant vitamins can elevate your wellness journey even further. That’s where Éternel comes in, a thoughtfully formulated antioxidant supplement designed to support your body’s natural defenses and promote a sense of vitality. It helps fill in the gaps and make sure you’re getting the most benefit from your healthy eating.

Here’s what makes Éternel stand out:

  • Beta-Glucan: Known for its ability to soothe and hydrate skin, beta-glucan supports your skin’s natural response to environmental stressors.
  • Magnesium Ascorbyl Phosphate (Vitamin C): A gentler, yet highly effective form of vitamin C that promotes collagen support and provides antioxidants for your skin and body.
  • Proprietary Vitality Super Fruit Blend: Featuring nutrient-dense fruits like dark sweet cherry, cranberry, mangosteen, and goji berry, this blend supports your body’s natural energy processes.
  • Resveratrol: A compound found in red wine and grapes that supports cellular health.
  • Coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10): Promotes cellular energy for enhanced vitality.
  • Glutathione: Referred to as the “master antioxidant,” glutathione is critical in supporting your body’s ability to handle oxidative stress and maintain balance.

When paired with a diet rich in natural antioxidants, Éternel works to complement your efforts by providing additional support to your cells to promote healthy aging. It contains a premium antioxidant blend and cellular absorption technology. It’s not about replacing good habits, it’s about amplifying them, and making Éternel part of your daily wellness routine can help you get there.

Practical Habits for Antioxidant Success

Incorporating antioxidants into your daily routine doesn’t have to be overwhelming. It’s about making small, intentional changes that add up over time. Here are a few easy tips to get started:

  • Double up on veggies:  Add an extra handful of spinach or kale to your salad or stir-fry. Better yet, add both. They are both high in different kinds of antioxidants. 
  • Snack smarter:  Swap processed snacks for antioxidant-rich options like berries, nuts, or dark chocolate. This has the benefit of eliminating foods that can be high in sugars and chemicals while adding in antioxidants 
  • Plan ahead:  Meal prep antioxidant-packed lunches and snacks to ensure you always have healthy options within reach. The more accessible healthy options are, the more likely you are to reach for them. 
  • Drink better:  Replace sugary drinks with water infused with lemon or cucumber, or sip on herbal teas throughout the day. Hydrated cells are healthy cells. 
  • Supplement wisely:  Incorporate Éternel into your routine for a convenient and effective way to enhance your antioxidant intake. 
  • Sleep: Sleep recalibrates the body and allows antioxidants to do their best work, supporting the body. 
  • Exercise: Your body can produce antioxidants naturally, and exercise helps jumpstart that process. Whether it’s going to the gym or taking a walk, moving your body has many benefits. 
  • Stress management: One of the easiest defenses against free radicals is to keep them from forming in the first place. Stress can increase free radical production, so keeping your cool can help your body too. 

 These small but meaningful shifts can create lasting habits, helping you support your body while maintaining a realistic and enjoyable lifestyle. 

Invest in Your Well-Being

Prioritizing antioxidants is about more than just your appearance, it’s about feeling strong, balanced, and ready to take on each day. By nourishing your body with antioxidant-rich foods, beverages, and supplements, you’re setting the stage for long-term wellness and vitality.

Éternel is more than a supplement; it’s a commitment to taking proactive steps toward your best self. Combined with healthy dietary choices, it helps you unlock your body’s full potential while supporting its natural processes.

If you’re ready to start prioritizing antioxidants in your life, now is the perfect time to take action. Explore the possibilities, build habits that last, and let Éternel be your partner on this journey.

By embracing a lifestyle rooted in wellness and incorporating powerful antioxidant habits, you’ll not only feel the benefits but also inspire others to prioritize their own health. Start small, stay consistent, and watch how these habits transform your energy, vitality, and outlook for the future.

Bonus tip: Curious about how to detox after the holidays or support your recovery routine with the right supplements? Check out Cleanse and Reset: Why Detoxing is the Perfect Way to End the Year or Tips to Restart a Gym Routine for more tips on supporting your health journey. Together with Éternel, these small steps create a ripple effect toward a vibrant, healthier you.

title: Haven’t Been to the Gym in a While? Tips to Restart a Routine (and Actually Stick to It)
description: Restart your fitness journey with practical tips to build a sustainable gym routine. Discover how Revíve by THREE™ supports recovery and keeps you energized in 2025!
author: Three
html:
If it’s been a while since you’ve hit the gym, the idea of starting again can feel intimidating. But don’t worry, getting back into a fitness routine doesn’t have to be overwhelming! With a few simple strategies, you can build a sustainable routine, stay consistent, and make progress that lasts.

Here’s how to restart your fitness journey and keep it going strong in 2025 (hint: it’s easier than you think!).

1. Start Simple: Make Movement a Habit

Don’t worry about doing complicated workouts or spending hours in the gym. Start small by incorporating 20-30 minutes of movement into your day. That could mean a brisk walk, some light stretching, or a beginner workout video. Building consistency is key, once you’ve made movement a habit, you can start adding more challenging exercises.

Practical Tip: Commit to just 2-3 gym sessions a week at first. This is enough to see progress without overwhelming yourself. As your routine becomes second nature, you can gradually add more days or intensity.

2. Set SMART Fitness Goals

When it comes to goal-setting, remember to be SMART: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. Instead of saying, “I want to get fit,” try something like, “I want to do 20 push-ups in a row within 4 weeks.” Clear goals help keep you motivated and give you something tangible to work toward.

Practical Tip: If you’re unsure where to start, try this simple workout goal:

  • Perform 3 sets of 10 reps of bodyweight squats, push-ups, and planks twice a week.
  • Each week, aim to increase the reps slightly (e.g., from 10 to 12 or 15).

3. Build a Balanced Routine

A solid workout routine should include:

  • Strength Training: Build muscle and boost metabolism with exercises like squats, lunges, push-ups, or resistance band work.
  • Cardio: Improve your cardiovascular health with walking, jogging, cycling, or dancing. Aim for 20-30 minutes of moderate cardio 3 times a week.
  • Flexibility and Mobility: Keep your body limber and injury-free by including stretching or yoga at least twice a week.

Practical Tip: Start your sessions with a warm-up (like 5-10 minutes of light cardio) and end with a cool-down to stretch and relax your muscles.

4. Plan Your Gym Time Like an Appointment

Treat your workouts like important appointments, you wouldn’t cancel a meeting with your boss, so don’t cancel on yourself! Choose a time that works for your schedule, whether it’s before work, during lunch, or in the evening.

Practical Tip: Block off 30-45 minutes in your calendar for your workouts. Having a set time helps you stick to the plan and eliminates the “I don’t have time” excuse.

5. Recovery is Just as Important as the Workout

When restarting a fitness routine, your body needs time to recover and adjust. Ignoring recovery can lead to burnout. Using a renewal and recovery supplement like Revíve by THREE™ can provide powerful support for your body’s natural inflammatory response, helping ease muscle stiffness and support healthy joints.

Revíve Benefits for Recovery:

  • Supports your body to bounce back faster with its blend of curcumin, boswellia, ginger, and shiitake mushroom
  • Supports joint comfort and mobility so you can stay active longer
  • Promotes a feeling of vitality to keep you energized for the next workout

Add Revíve to your post-workout routine for optimal recovery and a smoother path toward your fitness goals.

6. Stay Consistent with a Reward System

It’s easier to stick to a routine when you reward yourself along the way. Celebrate small milestones, whether it’s completing a week of workouts or lifting a heavier weight, with something that feels meaningful to you. (Pro tip: Avoid food-related rewards that undo your hard work.)

Practical Tip: Treat yourself to new workout gear, a massage, or a fun activity once you hit a fitness milestone. These rewards keep you motivated and make the journey enjoyable.

____________________________

Everything you need. Nothing you don't. 

Check out additional THREE products to complete your wellness routine. 

____________________________

7. Listen to Your Body

It’s normal to feel some muscle soreness when you’re starting out, but sharp pain or excessive fatigue is a sign you may be overdoing it. Pay attention to how your body feels and adjust your routine accordingly. Remember: consistency is more important than intensity, pace yourself for long-term success.

8. Fuel Your Body for Success

Your body needs proper fuel to perform well, recover efficiently, and stay consistent. Drink plenty of water, eat balanced meals with protein, carbs, and healthy fats, and consider incorporating supplements that support your journey.

Practical Tip: Add Revíve by THREE™ to your routine to support post-workout recovery and promote overall vitality. Its unique blend of ingredients helps your body handle the physical demands of exercise while keeping you energized.

9. Find a Fitness Buddy

Working out with a friend is a great way to stay motivated, hold yourself accountable, and make exercise more fun. If you don’t have a workout buddy, consider joining a group fitness class or an online community to connect with like-minded people.

Practical Tip: Challenge your buddy to try a new workout each week. The variety will keep things exciting and help you both stay on track.

Restarting Your Routine Made Simple

Getting back into fitness doesn’t have to be complicated. With a little planning, a commitment to consistency, and the right tools to support your body, you’ll be well on your way to crushing your fitness goals in 2025.

And remember, recovery is just as important as the workout itself. Whether you’re hitting the weights, running the trails, or trying yoga for the first time, Revíve by THREE™ can help support your body’s natural recovery process and keep you feeling great every step of the way.

What Is Bakuchiol?

Bakuchiol (pronounced buh-KOO-chee-all) is derived from the seeds and leaves of the Psoralea corylifolia plant, commonly known as the "babchi" plant. This ingredient has been used for centuries in traditional Ayurvedic and Chinese medicine, where it was prized for its calming and restorative properties. Today, Bakuchiol is making waves in the skincare world for its gentle yet effective results.

What Makes Bakuchiol Unique

  • Derived from Nature: Extracted from the Psoralea corylifolia plant, bakuchiol is a botanical powerhouse.
  • Universal Appeal: Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive or reactive skin.
  • Sustainably Sourced: Bakuchiol aligns with THREE’s mission to combine the best of nature with cutting-edge science.

The Benefits of Bakuchiol

  1. Supports Collagen Production
    Collagen is the building block of youthful-looking skin, but its production naturally decreases over time. Bakuchiol works to support the skin’s natural collagen processes, helping to maintain elasticity and firmness.
  2. Provides Antioxidant Support
    Environmental factors like UV rays and pollution can cause oxidative stress on the skin. Bakuchiol’s antioxidant properties help support the body’s natural reaction to these stressors, promoting a healthier-looking complexion.
  3. Hydrates the Skin
    Bakuchiol is known for its ability to hydrate the skin, enhancing its texture without causing irritation. It helps skin look more even-toned and refreshed, leaving behind a radiant glow.
  4. Minimizes the Appearance of Fine Lines and Wrinkles
    With regular use, Bakuchiol can reduce the visual appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, promoting a more youthful and refined complexion.
  5. Gentle on All Skin Types
    Unlike other active ingredients, Bakuchiol is gentle enough for all skin types, including sensitive skin. It delivers results without the irritation, redness, or dryness that some may experience with harsher skincare components.

Bakuchiol in Visage Super Serum

THREE’s Visage Super Serum incorporates Bakuchiol as one of its high-performing ingredients, combining nature’s best with advanced science. Paired with other powerhouse ingredients like Vitamin C, Allantoin, and Squalane, Bakuchiol plays a vital role in the serum’s ability to support collagen, support hydration, and visually smoother-looking skin.

What sets Visage Super Serum apart is its ability to deliver Bakuchiol directly where it’s needed, thanks to THREE’s advanced Cellular Absorption Technologies. This ensures maximum effectiveness, allowing you to see and feel the difference with every application.

Embrace the Bakuchiol Difference

title: The Real Monsters: How Heavy Metals Can Haunt Your Health
description: Discover how heavy metals like lead, mercury, and arsenic can impact your health, and learn how THREE's third-party testing ensures pure, safe supplements every time.
author: Three
html:
As Halloween approaches, we're all about embracing the spooky side of life, ghosts, goblins, and things that go bump in the night. But while most monsters are confined to the world of costumes and decorations, there are some real threats out there that we encounter every day. Heavy metals like lead, mercury, and arsenic are some of the scariest culprits, lurking in our environment and sometimes even in our food and water. These “real-life monsters” can sneak into our bodies, causing a host of health issues over time. At THREE, we’re committed to keeping these unwanted guests out of our products through rigorous third-party testing, so you can rest easy knowing that only the safest, purest ingredients are in every supplement you take.

The Spooky Side of Heavy Metals: What Are They and Why Are They Harmful?

Heavy metals are naturally occurring elements that can be found in soil, water, and air. While some, like iron and zinc, are essential in small amounts for our health, others can be toxic when they accumulate in the body. Lead, mercury, and arsenic, for example, are known to disrupt various bodily functions, from damaging the nervous system to interfering with cellular processes.

Lead – Known for its neurotoxic effects, lead can accumulate over time and negatively impact brain development, especially in children. Lead exposure has been linked to cognitive decline, memory issues, and mood changes in adults.

Mercury – A metal often associated with seafood, mercury can be damaging to the nervous system and kidneys. High levels of mercury exposure can cause tremors, vision problems, and even mood disturbances.

Arsenic – Often found in contaminated water and some food products, arsenic exposure is linked to skin issues, gastrointestinal distress, and even a higher risk of certain cancers.

These metals don't belong in our bodies, yet they can sometimes make their way in through environmental exposure, certain foods, and even some low-quality supplements.

How Heavy Metals Creep into Our Lives

Heavy metals can enter our bodies in various ways, often through everyday sources:

Contaminated Water and Soil – Water and soil can become contaminated with heavy metals from industrial waste, pesticides, and pollution. These contaminants can then end up in the foods we eat, especially those grown in affected areas.

Air Pollution – Heavy metals can be released into the air from industrial activities, mining, and vehicle emissions. Breathing in these particles can introduce them into our system over time.

Certain Foods – Some foods, such as seafood, rice, and leafy greens, can absorb heavy metals from the environment. While these foods are nutritious, consistent exposure to contaminated sources can lead to an accumulation of heavy metals in the body.

Low-Quality Supplements – Not all supplements are made with the same level of care. Without proper testing, some products may contain trace amounts of heavy metals that can accumulate in the body over time.

The Haunting Effects of Heavy Metal Accumulation

Heavy metals can quietly build up in the body, leading to long-term health effects that may not be immediately noticeable. Symptoms of heavy metal accumulation can range from fatigue and irritability to more severe conditions affecting the brain, kidneys, and liver. Over time, exposure to heavy metals has been linked to neurological disorders, compromised immune function, and even cardiovascular issues. It’s safe to say that these “monsters” can have a scary impact on overall wellness.

How THREE International Keeps the Monsters Away

At THREE, we’re dedicated to providing the highest quality supplements with ingredients that are as pure as they are effective. Our commitment to transparency, safety, and purity means we take every precaution to ensure that our products are free from harmful heavy metals and other contaminants. Here’s how we keep the monsters away:

  1. Third-Party Testing – Every THREE product undergoes rigorous third-party testing to detect and eliminate any unwanted contaminants, including heavy metals. By working with independent labs, we ensure unbiased, accurate results that meet the strictest standards.
  2. Global Sourcing Standards – We source our ingredients from trusted suppliers who prioritize quality and sustainability. Our team carefully evaluates each supplier, ensuring that they adhere to ethical practices and environmental safety standards.
  3. Commitment to Purity – Beyond testing, we maintain strict protocols throughout our manufacturing process to minimize the risk of contamination. From ingredient storage to the production floor, we take every step to guarantee that the supplements you receive are as pure and safe as possible.

In addition, the presence of THREE International's products in the Physicians' Desk Reference (PDR), a comprehensive drug information resource widely used by healthcare professionals, underscores the company's dedication to transparency and reliability, providing consumers with trusted information on supplement efficacy and safety.

Why It Matters to Choose Tested Supplements

Choosing supplements that undergo rigorous testing for heavy metals and other contaminants isn’t just about quality, it’s about protecting your long-term wellness. With THREE’s commitment to third-party testing and purity, you can trust that our products won’t come with any unwanted surprises. You deserve supplements that work with your body, not against it, and our focus on safety is just one way we uphold that promise.

The Final Word: Stay Safe and Supplement Smart

Heavy metals may be a real-world threat, but you don’t have to live in fear. By choosing high-quality, third-party tested supplements like those from THREE, you’re taking proactive steps to protect your body from these invisible “monsters.” This Halloween season, as we celebrate all things spooky, remember that your health doesn’t have to be haunted by hidden dangers. With THREE’s dedication to purity and safety, you can feel confident that our supplements are designed to support, not disrupt, your well-being.

You might not be familiar with the term “quorum sensing,” but it’s a fascinating process that plays a significant role in how bacteria communicate.
