title: Water-Based vs. Oil-Based Serums, Which Is Right for You?
description: Discover the differences between water-based and oil-based serums. Learn why Visage Super Serum’s water-based formula offers powerful results for your skin
author: Three
html:
When it comes to serums, one of the most important choices you’ll make is between a water-based or oil-based formula. Each type has its benefits, but understanding the differences will help you select the serum that best suits your skin’s needs.

In this article, we’ll explore the key distinctions between water-based and oil-based serums and give you the behind-the-scenes look at why Visage Super Serum is water-based.

What makes a water-based serum?

Water-based serums are (surprise!) usually formulated with water as their primary ingredient, making them light, fast-absorbing, and highly effective at delivering active ingredients deep into the skin. These serums are ideal when you want a lightweight feel and/or are looking to layer multiple products in your skincare routine.

The benefits of water-based serums

  • They’re lightweight and fast absorbing! As we explained previously, water-based serums are known for their light texture, which allows your skin to absorb them quickly, without leaving residue. This makes them an excellent choice for those with oily or combination skin, or for anyone who prefers a non-greasy finish.
  • They let ingredients penetrate more deeply into your skin. Because water is a universal solvent, it’s excellent at dissolving active ingredients and helping them penetrate the skin’s surface. This means that the active ingredients in water-based serums can work more effectively, reaching the deeper layers of the skin where they’re needed most!
  • They play well with others. If you enjoy a multi-step skincare routine, water-based serums are perfect for layering. Their lightweight texture allows them to be applied under other products without feeling heavy or clogging pores (which means you still get all the benefits from the rest of your routine).

Water-based serums offer a lightweight, fast-absorbing solution that delivers active ingredients deep into the skin, making them an essential part of any skincare routine.


What makes an oil-based serum?

These serums are made with oils as their primary ingredient, giving them a richer, more nourishing feel. There’s no doubt that oil-based serums are having a moment in the skincare world. Their rich texture and deep hydration make them particularly appealing to those looking for indulgent skincare products. However, while they may be trendy, oil-based serums can sometimes struggle to mix well with other products, which might limit their effectiveness, especially in a layered skincare routine.

The benefits of oil-based serums

  • They can really “lock in” moisture. Oil-based serums provide a rich layer of hydration that’s particularly beneficial for dry or dehydrated skin. The oils in these serums help to lock in moisture and create a protective barrier on the skin’s surface. They can, however, potentially lead to clogged pores or a greasy finish.
  • They’re champs at providing nourishment. Many oils are packed with vitamins and fatty acids that can help nourish your skin and soothe irritation or dryness. They can also help to smooth the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.
  • They can stay on your skin longer. Because of their rich texture, oil-based serums tend to stick around longer on the skin. This can also mean that it takes a longer time for your skin to absorb all the goodness contained within the serum, which risks the active ingredients being accidentally wiped off or otherwise removed before you can take full advantage.

Why did we choose to create Visage Super Serum as a water-based serum?

We wanted to create a serum that could be versatile, supremely effective, and beneficial for all skin types, which is why we opted for a water-based formulation for our Visage Super Serum.

Here’s why that stands out , Superior absorption and effectiveness.

Water is the universal solvent of life, and therefore plays a crucial role in our serum's formulation.

Water is what helps dissolve the 42 active ingredients in Visage Super Serum, allowing them to work together with our Cellular Absorption Technologies for rapid and effective absorption into the skin. This ensures that your skin gets all the benefits from the serum’s carefully chosen ingredients, including the ones we discovered through our research expeditions, like allantoin from the desert plantain. Water the latest episode of Explore with Dr. Dan to learn more about this powerful ingredient.

Lightweight, yet potent

Our water-based serum provides the perfect balance of a lightweight texture with potent results. It’s designed to absorb quickly without leaving any residue, making it suitable for all skin types, even those prone to oiliness or breakouts.

Because it mixes so effortlessly with other products, our water-based serum helps ensure that every step in your skincare routine works in harmony, maximizing the overall effectiveness of your regimen!

Preservative-free stability

We know how important it is to use products that are both effective and safe. That’s why our water-based serum doesn’t need harsh preservatives. Its unique molecular composition naturally inhibits bacterial growth, ensuring that the serum stays fresh and stable without compromising your skin’s health.

Which serum is right for you?

Choosing between a water-based and oil-based serum really comes down to your skin’s needs and your personal preferences.

While oil-based serums are trending for their rich hydration and luxurious feel, they may not always mix well with other products, which can affect the overall effectiveness of your skincare routine. If you’re looking for something light, fast-absorbing, and easy to layer, a water-based serum like Visage Super Serum is a fantastic choice that offers clear advantages.

At THREE International, we designed the Visage Super Serum to provide the best of what water-based serums offer, quick absorption, potent results, and a luxurious, refreshing experience that leaves your skin feeling revitalized. Whether you’re new to serums or simply looking to enhance your skincare routine, the Visage Super Serum is a powerful addition that can help you achieve the healthy, radiant skin you deserve.

title: Exploring the Hottest Place on Earth with Dr. Dan
description: Discover the hidden gems of the Mojave Desert with Dr. Dan as he uncovers powerful bioactive compounds in plants that thrive in the hottest place on Earth.
author: Three
html:
In the third episode of “Explore with Dr. Dan”, we journey to a place that many would consider inhospitable, the Mojave Desert, home to Death Valley, the hottest place on earth. Temperatures here have reached a scorching 134 degrees Fahrenheit. But what could possibly drive someone to explore this blistering landscape? The answer lies in the hidden treasures of this harsh environment: plants that not only survive but thrive, producing some of the most potent bioactive compounds found in nature.

Dr. Dan Gubler, THREE’s Chief Scientific Officer, takes us on a riveting expedition to discover these incredible plants, revealing their potential to support human health in remarkable ways.

Exploring the Mojave Desert: Nature's Hidden Gems

The Mojave Desert is an extreme environment, a place where only the toughest plants can survive. But in their struggle for survival, these plants have developed an arsenal of powerful molecules that could have profound benefits for human health. The intense conditions force the plants to produce bioactive compounds in higher concentrations, making them a goldmine for researchers like Dr. Dan.

 

"These plants haven't just learned how to survive; they've learned how to thrive, producing molecules that can support human health in ways we're only beginning to understand."

Dr. Dan

Discovering Hidden Treasures

During this episode, Dr. Dan uncovers several fascinating plants, each with its own unique potential:

Desert Trumpet Plant: Found only in the Mojave Desert, this plant is notable for its hollow sacs. Dr. Dan suspects that these sacs contain molecules that could support gut health, a discovery that could lead to new advancements in digestive wellness.

Apricot Malo: This rare plant might hold the key to better hair health. As Dr. Dan reveals, early studies suggest that the apricot malo contains molecules that could be beneficial for promoting healthy hair, a significant need in today’s world.

Desert Thistle: Already a star ingredient in THREE’s Purifí product, desert thistle is packed with silymarin, known for supporting intestinal wellness. But Dr. Dan isn’t stopping there, he’s on the hunt for even more powerful compounds within this hardy plant.

Ephedrine Neis: This plant was traditionally used by Native Americans and early settlers to create a tea that provided natural energy. The vibrant red color inside the stems hints at the bioactive goodies hidden within, and Dr. Dan is eager to unlock their potential for a future THREE product.

Joshua Tree: Known as the king of the Mojave Desert, the Joshua Tree is more than just a symbol of resilience, it’s a powerhouse of saponins, compounds that enhance the absorption of other nutrients. Dr. Dan is excited to see what new molecules this iconic tree might reveal.

The Grand Finale: Desert Plantain

The pinnacle of this expedition is the discovery of the desert plantain, a plant that has adapted to the extreme conditions of Death Valley in extraordinary ways. This plantain is rich in phytonutrients and possesses a unique composition that hasn’t been seen before. Dr. Dan is particularly excited about its potential to support skin health, and he hints that this discovery will play a pivotal role in a new THREE product that promises to revolutionize the industry.

 

"This is what fuels me. This is what exploration and science is all about, seeking the unknown, going out there and discovering it, taking it, and using it to support human health in ways that nobody else has."

Dr. Dan

The Hottest Nutrients from the Hottest Place on Earth

Dr. Dan’s expedition to the Mojave Desert is a testament to the power of nature and the potential of plants to offer groundbreaking support for human health. The extreme conditions of Death Valley have given rise to plants with unique, potent bioactive compounds, treasures that could be lost forever if not explored and studied.

As we wrap up Episode 3, the discoveries made in the Mojave Desert serve as a reminder of why it’s so important to explore new frontiers in health. These plants, with their incredible resilience and unique properties, could hold the key to future wellness innovations. Stay tuned as Dr. Dan continues his journey, uncovering the secrets of nature and bringing them to light for the benefit of us all.

title: What Are Liposomal Supplements, And Should You Make The Switch?
description: Discover the benefits of liposomal supplements, how they enhance nutrient absorption, and why they might be the best choice for your wellness routine.
author: Three
html:
Whether you’re looking to address specific health goals or want to support your overall wellness, you’ve probably given considerable thought to the supplements you take. But have you considered the different forms of supplements available to you?

Some nutrients, such as those found in our supplements Éternel, Purifí, Imúne, and Revíve, are formulated with THREE’s advanced liposomal technology. This unique delivery method can help your body better absorb essential nutrients and deliver them directly to the cells.

Wondering if liposomal supplements are right for you? Let’s dive into what liposomal supplements are, how they work, and why they might be the best choice for your wellness routine.

What Are Liposomal Supplements?

Liposomal supplements utilize liposomes, elegant in their simplicity, are minute spherical vesicles characterized by a lipid bilayer structure reminiscent of cell membranes. These liposomes encapsulate nutrients, forming a bubble to protect them from the harsh environment of the digestive system and ensuring they reach the bloodstream more effectively.

How Do Liposomes Work?

Picture liposomes as choreographers orchestrating a ballet of nutrient delivery within the body. Their simulation of cell membranes allows them to merge seamlessly with the body's natural processes, optimizing the absorption of key nutrients.

Protection

Traditional supplements often degrade in the stomach due to acidic conditions. Liposomes protect the nutrients, ensuring they stay intact until they reach the small intestine.

Enhanced Absorption

The structure of liposomes mimics our cell membranes, allowing for easier fusion and delivery of nutrients directly into the cells.

Bioavailability

By protecting and efficiently delivering nutrients, liposomes significantly increase the bioavailability of the supplements, meaning your body can utilize more of the active ingredients.

Benefits of Liposomal Supplements

Improved Nutrient Delivery

The primary advantage of liposomal supplements is their ability to deliver nutrients more efficiently. This means you get more of the essential vitamins and minerals you need.

Reduced Serving Requirements

Because of the enhanced absorption, you often need smaller servings of liposomal supplements compared to traditional forms to achieve the same effect.

Gentle on the Stomach

The protective nature of liposomes reduces the likelihood of gastrointestinal discomfort, making them a great choice for those with sensitive stomachs.

Should You Make The Switch?

If you’re looking for a way to maximize the benefits of your supplements, switching to liposomal forms might be the answer. Here’s why:

Higher Efficiency

Liposomal supplements ensure that you’re getting the most out of each serving, which can be especially important for those looking to address specific health goals.

Convenience

With enhanced absorption, you may find that you need to take fewer pills or smaller amounts of liquid, simplifying your supplement routine.

Targeted Health Benefits

At THREE, our liposomal supplements are designed with specific health goals in mind:

  • Éternel: Contains liposomal antioxidants, including Glutathione to neutralize free radicals and reduce oxidative stress.

title: 4 Fun Activities to Keep You Active for the 4th of July
description: Celebrate the Fourth of July with these fun and active ideas! Stay energized and healthy with outdoor games, family hikes, simple workouts, and water activities.
author: Three
html:
The Fourth of July is a day filled with celebration, fireworks, and delicious food. It's also the perfect opportunity to incorporate some fun and active activities into your day to keep everyone moving and energized. Here are four exciting ways to stay active and enjoy the holiday to the fullest, plus take advantage of some exciting Summer Power Packs that can help you power up for summer and take your wellness to the next level!

1. Outdoor Games and Activities

One of the best ways to stay active on the Fourth of July is to engage in outdoor games and activities. Gather your family and friends for a friendly game of frisbee, soccer, or volleyball. These activities not only get your heart pumping but also provide a great way to bond and create lasting memories.

For a fun twist, set up a scavenger hunt in your backyard or a nearby park. Create a list of patriotic-themed items for everyone to find, such as a small American flag, a red, white, and blue ribbon, or a picture of a historic landmark. This activity encourages everyone to get moving while embracing the spirit of the holiday.

2. Family Walk or Hike

A family walk or hike is a fantastic way to enjoy the beautiful summer weather while staying active. Choose a scenic trail or a local park and explore the natural surroundings. Not only will you get a good workout, but you'll also have the chance to appreciate the beauty of nature.

To make the walk or hike even more engaging, bring along a camera and take pictures of interesting plants, animals, or landmarks you encounter along the way. This can turn your hike into a mini-adventure and provide a wonderful opportunity to connect with your loved ones.

3. Simple Workout Routines

If you're looking for a more structured way to stay active, try incorporating simple workout routines into your Fourth of July festivities. Set up a designated workout area in your backyard or living room and invite everyone to join in. You can create a circuit of exercises, such as jumping jacks, push-ups, squats, and lunges.

For a fun and festive twist, play patriotic music in the background and turn your workout into a dance party. Dancing is a great way to burn calories and have a blast at the same time. Plus, it's an activity that people of all ages can enjoy.

4. Water Activities

Beat the summer heat by incorporating water activities into your Fourth of July celebrations. Whether you have access to a pool, a lake, or even just a sprinkler in your backyard, water activities are a fun way to stay cool and active.

Organize a water balloon toss, set up a slip-and-slide, or have a friendly relay race in the pool. These activities not only keep everyone moving but also provide a refreshing way to enjoy the holiday. Remember to stay hydrated and apply sunscreen regularly to protect your skin from the sun.

title: The Secret to Supporting Your Body’s Natural Defenses

Every day, we are exposed to various elements that can negatively impact our health, from UV radiation to pollution. But how do we give healthy support to our bodies? One powerful way is by embracing antioxidants and ensuring we’re getting enough of them. Antioxidants play a crucial role in providing healthy support to our cells, and among them, Glutathione is one of the most powerful. But what exactly makes Glutathione so special, and how does it benefit you? Let’s explore this key ingredient and discover why it deserves a top spot in your wellness routine.

What is Glutathione?

Glutathione is a tripeptide composed of three amino acids: cysteine, glutamine, and glycine. It's naturally produced in the liver and found in every cell of the body, acting as a major support for healthy cellular function. But what makes Glutathione so special?

At its core, Glutathione functions as a master antioxidant. Its unique chemical structure allows it to neutralize free radicals effectively, those unstable molecules that can wreak havoc on our cells. Additionally, Glutathione plays a vital role in detoxification, immune function, and cellular repair, making it indispensable for maintaining overall health.

The Benefits of Glutathione

Neutralizing Free Radicals: Free radicals are byproducts of various metabolic processes and environmental factors like pollution and UV radiation. Left unchecked, they can cause oxidative stress, leading to unhealthy aging. Glutathione steps in as a potent free radical scavenger, helping to neutralize these harmful molecules and supporting our cells.

Reducing Oxidative Stress: Oxidative stress occurs when there's an imbalance between free radicals and antioxidants in the body. By replenishing antioxidant levels, Glutathione helps to restore balance and reduce oxidative stress.

Supporting Immune Function: Glutathione is essential for a healthy immune system. It enhances the activity of certain cells, such as lymphocytes, supporting the body’s natural immune response.

Enhancing Cellular Health and Longevity: Glutathione supports cellular health by promoting healthy cell function. This process is vital for overall cellular longevity.

Promoting Detoxification: The liver relies on Glutathione to detoxify harmful substances, including heavy metals, pollutants, and toxins. By supporting liver function, Glutathione aids in the body's natural detoxification processes.

Glutathione in Éternel: The Antioxidant Super Blend

At THREE, we've formulated Éternel to harness the full potential of Glutathione and other powerful liposomal antioxidants and polyphenols. Éternel's blend is designed to maximize the  synergistic effects of its ingredients, creating a comprehensive antioxidant powerhouse with improved cellular absorption.

In addition to Glutathione, Éternel includes other key antioxidants like vitamin C, vitamin E, CoQ10 and resveratrol. These ingredients work together to enhance Glutathione's effectiveness, providing multi-faceted support for cellular health and vitality.

How to Support Glutathione Levels Naturally

While our bodies produce Glutathione naturally, various factors like aging, poor diet, and stress can deplete its levels. Here are some ways to support Glutathione levels naturally:

Foods Rich in Glutathione: Include sulfur-rich foods in your diet, such as garlic, onions, broccoli, and Brussels sprouts. These foods support Glutathione production.

Lifestyle Changes: Regular exercise, adequate sleep, and stress management techniques like meditation and yoga can enhance Glutathione levels.

Supplements: Incorporating a supplement like Éternel into your daily routine ensures that you receive a consistent and potent dose of Glutathione and other essential antioxidants.

Fun Facts About Glutathione

Historical Uses: Glutathione has been studied for over a century, with early research highlighting its importance in cellular support and detoxification.

Trivia: Did you know that Glutathione is often referred to as the "master antioxidant"? Its ability to regenerate other antioxidants like vitamin C and E makes it a critical player in the antioxidant network.

Embrace the Antioxidant Advantage

Glutathione is undeniably one of nature's most powerful antioxidants, offering a wide range of benefits from neutralizing free radicals to supporting immune function and cellular health. By incorporating Éternel into your daily routine, you can harness the power of Glutathione and other key antioxidants to promote overall wellness and vitality. author: Three
html:
Our Chief Scientific Officer, Dr. Dan Gubler, Ph.D., was recently featured on the popular podcast Optimal Protein Podcast (Fast Keto) hosted by Vanessa Spina. In the episode titled "Epigenetics: How To Optimize Your Genes with Ketosis, Intermittent Fasting, Phytonutrients and More!" Dr. Gubler shared his extensive knowledge on biochemical processes, organic chemistry, and phytonutrients. Here, we’ll highlight the key points discussed in the podcast and dive into how Dr. Gubler's work at THREE International is redefining the standards of nutritional health.

Understanding Epigenetics and Its Impact on Health

Dr. Gubler began by explaining the concept of epigenetics, which involves the study of how genes are turned on or off and how this regulation affects our health. Unlike genetic testing, which only tells us the propensity for an issue to occur, epigenetics provides real-time insights into whether a gene is expressed or not. Essentially, it's about ensuring that the genes we want activated are indeed turned on by the foods we eat, ketones, and various practices such as grounding and deep breathing.

The Role of Ketones in Epigenetics

One of the fascinating aspects of the discussion was the role of ketones in epigenetics. Ketones are not just fuel for the body; they also play a significant role in gene regulation. Dr. Gubler highlighted that ketones are crucial in support of genes related to insulin, as well as cognitive health. He emphasized that ketones help support the production of Brain-Derived Neurotrophic Factor (BDNF), a protein vital for brain health.

Intermittent Fasting and Resistance Training

Intermittent fasting and resistance training were also discussed as powerful tools for optimizing epigenetics. Dr. Gubler explained that intermittent fasting allows the body to focus on homeostasis and proper gene regulation by reducing the number of biochemical reactions occurring at any given time. This period of rest enables the body to maintain its internal balance and improve overall function.

Signal Transduction Cascades: The Domino Effect

Dr. Gubler provided insights into signal transduction cascades, which are biochemical pathways that lead to the activation of genes. He likened these cascades to a domino effect, where each domino represents a step in the process. Ketones are one of the key molecules involved in these cascades, highlighting their importance in gene support and overall health.

The Importance of Lifestyle Factors

Dr. Gubler emphasized that lifestyle factors such as diet, sleep, exercise, stress management, and environmental factors play a crucial role in epigenetics. Poor lifestyle choices can hinder the body's ability to produce ketones and maintain proper gene support. He recommended practices like intermittent fasting and a balanced diet rich in phytonutrients to support optimal epigenetic function.

Choosing the Right Supplements

Vanessa Spina and Dr. Gubler discussed the importance of choosing high-quality supplements that contain essential vitamins, minerals, trace minerals, and phytonutrients. Dr. Gubler stressed the significance of absorption, explaining that even the most powerful molecules are ineffective if they are not absorbed into the cells. He advised selecting supplements with advanced technologies that enhance bioavailability. Learn more about Vitalité by THREE, a highly bioavailable Superfood Blend + Daily Multivitamin Complex.

Caffeine: The Misunderstood Molecule

The podcast also touched on caffeine, a widely studied molecule that often receives mixed reviews. Dr. Gubler pointed out that caffeine has several proven benefits, including healthy support of microbiome health. He highlighted that the key to reaping the benefits of caffeine lies in moderation and understanding its effects on the body.

That’s right, when you support gut health and a healthy gut microbiome, you support digestion, metabolism and weight, a healthy inflammatory response, nutrient absorption and energy, and more. What is Gut Health?

Your gut is a microbiome home to bacteria, and while we often think of it as negative, the truth is many of them are necessary. They help break down food, produce enzymes, and are helpful as long as they are kept in check. That’s why your digestive health is so important. A healthy gut helps maintain the balance between beneficial and harmful microorganisms and supports overall wellness.

Incorporating Revíve into your wellness routine can help maintain a balanced gut microbiome, essential for optimal digestive health.

  • Supporting Adaptive and Innate Immune Systems: Imúne supports both the adaptive and innate immune responses, which help your body quickly recognize threats, and support an overall healthy immune response.

There are a lot of things you can do to support gut health naturally. Incorporating some of these healthy habits will go a long way to better overall health.

  • Fiber: Fiber is the unsung hero of the digestive system. It acts like a broom to sweep your stomach and intestines and keep things moving through. Getting enough fiber in your diet can help avoid constipation and feed good bacteria.

  • Exercise: Movement is good for your whole body, not just your muscles. When you exercise, you support a healthy inflammatory response and increase the bacterial diversity in your gut.

  • Hydration: A hydrated body is a happy body. Similarly to fiber, staying hydrated helps break down food and keeps things moving in your digestive tract.

  • Pre, Pro, and Postbiotics: Prebiotics provide nourishment for good bacteria, probiotics introduce beneficial bacteria, and postbiotics support the gut lining and overall gut function.

What are Prebiotics, Probiotics, and Postbiotics

You’ve no doubt heard of prebiotics, probiotics, and postbiotics before. Those terms get thrown around a lot, but here’s what they mean, and what they do to support gut health.

  • Prebiotics: This is a type of fiber your body can’t digest. The reason it’s important is that it feeds your gut bacteria and helps it do its job. You can get prebiotics naturally through fruits, vegetables, legumes, and whole grains.

  • Probiotics: These are the good microorganisms your gut needs to stay balanced. They provide support for your immune system and general wellness and can be found in yogurt with live, active cultures, and fermented foods like kimchi and kombucha.

  • Postbiotics: As prebiotics feed on probiotics, they produce postbiotics. They aren’t just a byproduct; they also support a healthy inflammatory response and antioxidant properties and aid in absorption and immune function.

You’ll experience a supported digestive process and overall gut function. 
  • Holistic Health: Beyond gut health, the combination of these supplements supports natural energy and a healthy immune system response. It’s a holistic approach to wellness that starts with supported gut health.

A healthy gut is foundational to overall wellness, influencing various aspects of health from supporting healthy digestion to supporting a healthy immune system response. The Importance of Bioactives and Cellular Absorption

Bioactives are compounds found in foods and supplements that have an effect on living tissues. Both have been extensively studied for their potential health benefits, which include supporting a healthy inflammatory response, antioxidant properties, and overall wellness.

However, the effectiveness of these bioactives largely depends on their bioavailability – that is, the extent and rate at which they are absorbed into the bloodstream and utilized by the body. title: Revíve and Thrive: Enhancing Your Exercise Routine
description: Explore the transformative power of exercise and discover how Revíve by THREE supports your active lifestyle with joint and recovery support.
author: Three
html:
In today's fast-paced world, where time flies and responsibilities pile up, prioritizing our health can sometimes take a back seat. However, one of the most effective ways to boost your well-being doesn't require a lot of time or fancy equipment: exercise. There are more benefits of exercise than a number on a scale. Movement and exercise impact nearly every system in the body. An active lifestyle can support immune system health, support a positive mood state, enhance natural energy levels, support joint health and offer a better quality of life.

If you want to maximize your exercise benefits, consistency is key. In fact, consistency is more important than intensity. Allowing for muscle recovery after exercise is another important and often overlooked part of a fitness routine. Learn more about the benefits of exercise and how Revíve by THREE can help with exercise recovery as you journey to a healthier lifestyle.

The Many Benefits of Exercise

There are many reasons why exercise is important. It offers a plethora of benefits that extend far beyond just physical appearance. When you make a healthy exercise routine a regular part of your life, you can expect:

Physical Benefits

Weight Management: Regular physical activity aids in shedding extra pounds and maintaining a healthy weight.

Enhanced Muscle Strength: It promotes stronger muscles, contributing to overall physical resilience.

Heart Health: Exercise strengthens the heart, fostering longevity.

Increased Endurance: You'll notice a significant improvement in stamina, helping you complete daily tasks with vigor.

Healthy Bones: Exercise, and strength training in particular, contributes to bone health. The physical stress helps build bone density and bone tissue in order to adapt to the strain.

Enhanced Metabolism: Physical activity burns calories while you’re exercising, but it also creates an afterburn effect known as excess post-exercise oxygen consumption, or EPOC for short. This means your body continues to use more oxygen than normal as it recovers from exercise, resulting in burning additional calories and enhancing metabolism.

Overall Well-Being

Stress Alleviation: Exercise serves as a potent stress-reliever, triggering the release of endorphins.

Heightened Cognitive Function: It enhances cognitive abilities.

Enhanced Sleep Quality: Regular physical activity promotes restful sleep, resulting in rejuvenation and improved overall well-being.

Mental and Emotional Benefits

Reduced Stress: Exercise can help you manage stress. It can provide a distraction from your problems while also releasing tension and promoting deeper breathing.

Supported Mood: Movement increases endorphins, which supports a positive mood state and overall well-being, but there’s more to it than that. It can help increase your confidence.

Brain Health: Exercise increases the amount of blood flow to the brain, which is essential to overall brain health.

Overcoming Common Exercise Barriers

While it's easy to find excuses to skip exercise, addressing common barriers can help you stay committed to your fitness goals:

Time Constraints: Incorporate short, high-intensity workouts into your day or break longer sessions into manageable chunks.

Boredom: Experiment with different activities to find ones you enjoy, such as dancing, hiking, or cycling, to keep exercise engaging and enjoyable.

Resilience: Start with gentle exercises and gradually increase intensity as your energy levels improve, leveraging exercise's energizing effects.

Integrating Exercise into Your Daily Routine

Exercise isn't merely a short-term commitment; it's a lifelong journey toward better health and vitality. When considering how to stay active, consistency is key. Prioritize regular physical activity to reap the long-term rewards. Even with a busy schedule, you can infuse more activity into your day with these practical strategies and easy ways to stay active:

Desk Exercises: Incorporate simple exercises like seated leg lifts or shoulder stretches into your workday to combat the effects of prolonged sitting.

Walking Breaks: Take short walks during breaks, incorporate walking meetings, or take a walk after meals to accumulate steps throughout the day.

Mini-Workouts: Break your exercise routine into shorter sessions, focusing on different muscle groups each time, to fit physical activity into even the busiest schedule.

Habit Stacking: If you can pair your exercise with another habit you’ve already mastered, you’re more likely to stick with it. The theory behind habit stacking is that incorporating a new routine with one you’re already familiar with will increase the likelihood that you will continue.

Stretch Breaks: Exercise doesn’t have to equal an elevated heart rate. Even taking time for regular stretch breaks will help your body release tension and feel better.

The Many Benefits of Exercise Recovery

It’s important to incorporate recovery into your exercise routine if you want to get the full benefits. Exercise puts stress and strain on your body. This can ultimately make you stronger and healthier when done in moderation, but too much exercise has the opposite effect.

What Happens During Recovery?

Exercise recovery time allows your muscles to rebuild stronger, gives your body a chance to reset cortisol levels, and can support the health of your immune system. So while many people are hesitant to take a day off of training, incorporating regular recovery actually helps improve your overall performance.

Signs Your Body Needs Recovery

A little soreness after exercise is normal, and being sore doesn’t necessarily mean you should take a recovery day. But if you find you’re in a constant state of soreness, suffering from fatigue, experiencing declining performance results, feeling joint stiffness, or having trouble sleeping, these are all signs you need a recovery day.

Healthy Recovery Habits

A good exercise routine incorporates recovery. This can come in the form of designated recovery days, as well as prioritizing sleep, hydration, nutrition, stretching, and mobility work. All of these will help you come back stronger and healthier than you were before.

Revíve: Supporting Your Active Lifestyle

Enter Revíve by THREE – your exercise recovery and joint support ally. Formulated with a dynamic blend of ingredients including curcumin, boswellia, açaí berry, ginger, and shiitake mushroom, Revíve plays a vital role in:

Exercise Recovery: Revíve aids in post-workout recovery, easing muscle stiffness and promoting joint health to keep you moving freely.

Enhanced Vitality: Revíve's revitalizing B vitamin properties help boost vitality before and after exercise.

Natural Inflammatory Response: Revíve supports your body's natural inflammatory response, helping aid in recovery.

Support Your Recovery with Revíve

While we often see exercise as a chore, the reality is it elevates your overall well-being and sets the stage for a healthier, happier you. You don't need hours at the gym; you just need to move and incorporate adequate recovery and proper nutrition into your routine as well. With the support of Revíve by THREE, your journey to an active, vibrant life is within reach. Revíve contains a unique blend of key ingredients designed to support mobility, flexibility, and recovery. title: A Guide to the ‘biotics: Pre and Postbiotics in Purifí and Vitalité
description: Discover the power of prebiotics and postbiotics in Purifí and Vitalité. Learn how these nutrients support your gut and overall well-being.
author: Three
html:
In the beautiful symphony that makes up the complexity of the human body, there's a microscopic ecosystem quietly at work within each of us, known as the microbiome. It's a bustling metropolis teeming with trillions of bacteria, fungi, and other microorganisms, residing primarily in our gut and on our skin. While the thought of this bustling community might make some germaphobes squirm, the truth is, these tiny inhabitants play a vital role in our overall health and well-being.

The Power Duo: Prebiotics and Postbiotics

Enter prebiotics and postbiotics, the unsung heroes of the microbiome. Found in our supplements, Purifí and Vitalité, these ingredients work synergistically to nourish and support the delicate balance of our gut flora, promoting digestive health, immune response, and overall vitality.

But before we delve into the specifics of prebiotics and postbiotics, let's take a moment to appreciate the remarkable world of the microbiome.

For all you germaphobes out there, it may make you uncomfortable to know that on any given day there are likely trillions of bacteria living on your skin and in your gut. Before you run out to get a crazy “detoxifying” colonic, try celebrating these tiny inhabitants instead. What you put in and on your body can play a powerful role in your overall wellness, healthy aging, and wellbeing. You’ll see that bacteria aren’t all bad and, in fact, there are some we can’t live without. The goal is to nurture and support commensal microbes, as they can support digestion, vitamin production, and a healthy immune response. And, they keep the dangerous microbes from taking over and causing harm.

Now, let's turn our attention to prebiotics. These indigestible fibers serve as food for the beneficial bacteria in our gut, helping them thrive and multiply. In essence, prebiotics act as fertilizer for the good bugs, allowing them to flourish and maintain a healthy balance within the microbiome.

Meanwhile, postbiotics (have you heard of these before?) are the beneficial compounds produced by the fermentation of prebiotics in the gut. It seems that pre and probiotics get all of the credit, but postbiotics include short-chain fatty acids, vitamins, enzymes, and other bioactive molecules that exert various health-promoting effects on the body. By supporting the production of postbiotics, prebiotics play a crucial role in maintaining gut health and overall well-being.

Nourishing Your Microbiome with Purifí and Vitalité

In Purifí and Vitalité, we've carefully formulated these products to harness the power of pre and postbiotics, providing your body with the support it needs to thrive. Our prebiotic-rich blends nourish your gut microbiota, while the resulting postbiotics help maintain a healthy inflammatory status in the body, support immune response, and promote overall wellness.

But the benefits of prebiotics and postbiotics extend beyond gut health. Emerging research suggests that these compounds may also play a role in supporting skin vitality and metabolic balance. By nurturing your microbiome with Purifí and Vitalité, you're not only supporting your digestive system but also laying the foundation for overall wellness and vitality.

Embracing Bacteria: A Key to Wellness

So, the next time you think about wellness, remember to embrace the tiny inhabitants of your microbiome. With the right support from prebiotics and postbiotics, you can nourish your gut, support your immune response, and unlock a world of health and vitality from within.

It's time to celebrate the remarkable world of the microbiome and harness its power for a healthier, happier you.

title: Amino Acids in Vitalité Are the Building Blocks of Wellness
description: Discover the power of amino acids in Vitalité. Support overall health, vitality, and longevity with our premium multi-vitamin formula with 16 amino acids.
author: Three
html:
As we pursue optimal health and vitality, it's essential to understand the role that amino acids play in supporting vitality. These fundamental building blocks of life are not only crucial for protein synthesis but also contribute to a wide range of physiological processes that are vital for overall well-being. In this blog, we'll explore the importance of amino acids, particularly those found in our daily multivitamin, Vitalité, and explore how they can help you achieve your wellness goals.

The Basics of Amino Acids

Before we dive into the specific amino acids included in Vitalité and their benefits, let's start with the basics. Amino acids are organic compounds that serve as the building blocks of proteins, which are essential for the health of tissues and organs in the body. There are 20 standard amino acids, each with its unique chemical structure and role.

These amino acids can be classified into two categories: essential and non-essential. Essential amino acids cannot be synthesized by the body and must be obtained through diet or supplementation. Non-essential amino acids, on the other hand, can be produced by the body itself, although they may also be obtained from dietary sources.

The Role of Amino Acids in Health and Wellness

Amino acids play a crucial role in various physiological processes, including:

  1. Protein Synthesis: Amino acids are the building blocks of proteins, which are essential for the maintenance of tissues in the body. Protein synthesis is necessary for muscle development, immune response, and enzyme activity.
  2. Neurotransmitter Production: Certain amino acids serve as precursors for neurotransmitters, which are chemical messengers that facilitate communication between nerve cells in the brain and nervous system.
  3. Energy Production: Amino acids can be metabolized to produce energy when carbohydrates and fats are not available. This process, known as gluconeogenesis, involves converting amino acids into glucose to fuel various metabolic processes in the body.
  4. Antioxidant Activity: Some amino acids, such as cysteine and glycine, are components of antioxidant enzymes that help provide support to cells from oxidative stress caused by free radicals. By neutralizing free radicals, these amino acids contribute to overall health and longevity.
  5. Immune Response: Amino acids play a vital role in supporting immune response by aiding in the production of antibodies, cytokines, and other immune system components.

Amino Acids in Vitalité: Enhancing Your Wellness Journey

Vitalité, our premium superfood blend & multivitamin complex formulation, contains a carefully selected blend of amino acids, vitamins, 72 trace minerals, and other nutrients to support overall wellness. Let's take a closer look at some of the key amino acids found in Vitalité and their specific benefits:

  1. Lysine: Lysine is an essential amino acid that plays a critical role in protein synthesis, collagen formation, and healthy tissue. It also supports immune function and helps maintain healthy bones and connective tissues.
  2. Methionine: Methionine is another essential amino acid that serves as a precursor for various important molecules in the body, including glutathione, a powerful antioxidant. It also plays a role in detoxification and the metabolism of fats.
  3. Arginine: Arginine is a conditionally essential amino acid that plays a crucial role in blood vessel health and cardiovascular health.
  4. Glycine: Glycine is a non-essential amino acid that supports the synthesis of collagen, the primary structural protein in connective tissues, skin, and bones.
  5. Glutamine: Glutamine is a conditionally essential amino acid that plays a vital role in immune function, intestinal vitality, and muscle recovery.

In all, there are 16 amino acids in our proprietary plant and mineral blend formulated in Vitalité. By incorporating Vitalité into your daily wellness routine, you can help ensure that your body receives these essential nutrients and more. With its potent blend of amino acids, vitamins, and minerals, Vitalité provides comprehensive support for overall vitality and longevity.

Get a Daily Dose of Wellness

Amino acids are the building blocks of life, playing essential roles in protein synthesis, neurotransmitter production, energy metabolism, antioxidant activity, and immune responses. By including Vitalité in your daily regimen, you can optimize your intake of these crucial nutrients and support your body's overall wellness. description: Discover the benefits of liquid and marine collagen with Collagène by THREE. Enhance skin, hair, nails and immune system support naturally.

Collagen, often referred to as the body's "building blocks," is a vital protein responsible for maintaining the health and integrity of our skin, hair, nails, joints, and more. As we age, our natural collagen production declines, leading to visible signs of aging and decreased joint flexibility. In response, many turn to collagen supplements to replenish lost stores and support overall well-being. In this comprehensive guide, we'll explore the differences between two popular types of collagen supplements: liquid collagen and marine collagen. By understanding their unique properties and benefits, you can make an informed decision about which option best suits your needs.

Understanding Collagen

Before we explore the specifics of liquid and marine collagen, let's first understand the role of collagen in the body. Collagen is a fibrous protein that serves as a structural scaffold, providing strength, elasticity, and support to various tissues and organs. It accounts for a significant portion of our skin, bones, tendons, ligaments, and cartilage, making it essential for overall wellness and vitality.

Types of Collagen

Collagen is classified into several types, each with its own unique structure and function. The most abundant types of collagen in the human body are types I, II, and III. Type I collagen is predominant in the skin, bones, tendons, and ligaments, providing strength and structure. Type II collagen is found primarily in cartilage, while type III collagen supports the structure of organs, muscles, and blood vessels.

Liquid Collagen

Liquid collagen supplements are formulated with hydrolyzed collagen peptides, which are broken down into smaller molecules for easier absorption. This form of collagen is typically derived from bovine or marine sources and is available in liquid form for convenient consumption. Liquid collagen is prized for its high bioavailability, meaning that it is readily absorbed and utilized by the body. Additionally, liquid collagen supplements often contain added ingredients such as vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants to enhance their effectiveness.

Marine Collagen

Marine collagen is derived from fish or other marine sources, such as deep-sea fish skin or scales. Unlike bovine collagen, which is sourced from cows, marine collagen is rich in type I collagen, which closely resembles the collagen found in human skin. This similarity in structure makes marine collagen highly bioavailable and effective for supporting skin health and elasticity. Additionally, marine collagen is known for its superior absorption compared to other sources of collagen, making it an ideal choice for those seeking visible results.

This further enhances the absorption of the collagen and key ingredients to maximize their effectiveness. Collagène is backed by science and clinically shown to be 7.3X more bioavailable than standard organic molecules. Our innovative technologies ensure that your body can absorb and utilize the collagen more efficiently, leading to better results in less time.

Comprehensive Formula: In addition to type I liquid marine collagen, Collagène is enriched with additional beneficial ingredients such as hyaluronic acid, biotin, keratin, vitamin C, and pomegranate juice concentrate. Keratin supports healthy looking hair. Hyaluronic acid offers hydration and elasticity to the skin, keeping it more supple and preventing water loss. Pomegranate juice concentrate is a natural antioxidant that helps protect your cells from oxidative stress. Vitamin C and biotin work in harmony with collagen to optimize your body's collagen production process.

Conclusion

Understanding Omega-3 Fatty Acids

Omega-3 fatty acids are a class of polyunsaturated fats renowned for their unique structure and powerful health-promoting properties. At the cellular level, they are vital building blocks, supporting the structure of cell membranes and fueling key signaling pathways that influence everything from energy production to immune support.

There are three main types of omega-3 fatty acids:

  • ALA (alpha-linolenic acid), found mainly in plant sources, like flaxseeds and walnuts
  • EPA (eicosapentaenoic acid), found abundantly in fatty fish, such as salmon, mackerel, and sardines
  • DHA (docosahexaenoic acid), found abundantly in marine sources

These fatty acids are not produced by the body and must be obtained through diet or supplementation, making them essential components of a balanced nutritional regimen. When choosing an omega-3 supplement, it is important to consider the bioavailability of the omega-3 you are choosing. For example, ALA has its benefits, but the body must convert it into EPA and DHA in order to utilize it. This is why it is important to select supplements that are developed for optimal absorption.

  • Heart health - Omega-3s can help maintain triglyceride levels, support a healthy inflammatory response, and may support healthy blood pressure levels.
  • Joint health - Omega-3s have been shown to help support the body’s inflammatory response.

With Vitalité, you can embark on a journey to optimal wellness with confidence, knowing that you're fueling your body with the highest quality nutrients and enzyme delivery.

Incorporating Omega-3 Fish Oil Into Your Wellness Routine

title: Forming Healthy Habits Through Community
description: Discover the power of community in forming healthy habits. Learn practical tips and how social support boosts success. Join the journey with THREE.
author: Three
html:
Forming healthy habits is essential for long-term well-being, but it's not always easy. We've heard it said that it takes 21 days to form a habit. We've seen the headlines promoting how to quit something in 7 days, and of course the infamous New Year's resolutions that never quite stick year after year. And although forming new habits is challenging, it's crucial for us to keep trying! According to a study led by Phillipa Lally at the University College London, the average amount of time to form new habits hovers around 66 days. Our brains are divinely designed to form new habits. It's what scientists have labeled, "neuroplasticity." Telling ourselves the truth about the timeline to form habits will actually empower us to stick with it without being let down along the way. So let's explore three practical strategies that can help us for building habits and three common hurdles that can make it challenging. Plus, discover how having a friend by your side and community around you can provide valuable support on your journey.

Common Hurdles to Forming Habits

1. Lack of Consistency

Inconsistency can derail even the best intentions. Life's demands and distractions can disrupt your routine, making it difficult to maintain new habits. Overcome this hurdle by planning ahead, prioritizing your wellness goals, and finding creative solutions to stay consistent, even when faced with challenges.

2. Negative Self-Talk and Self-Doubt

Inner critics and self-limiting beliefs can undermine your efforts to form healthy habits. Negative thoughts like "I'm not disciplined enough" or "I'll never stick to this" or "I've been doing this for 14 days and still don't see results" can erode your confidence and motivation. Combat self-doubt by practicing self-compassion, challenging negative thoughts, and focusing on your strengths and progress rather than perfection.

3. Lack of Support or Accountability

Trying to build habits alone can be lonely and isolating. Without support or accountability, it's easy to lose motivation and revert to old behaviors. Seek out community, whether it's joining a fitness class, participating in online forums, or partnering with a friend or mentor who shares your wellness journey.

Practical Ways to Build Healthy Habits

1. Start Small and Be Consistent

Begin by setting achievable goals and gradually increasing them over time. Consistency is key; aim to practice your new habit daily or on a regular schedule. Whether it's drinking more water, exercising regularly, taking a daily multivitamin or incorporating more fruits and vegetables into your diet, small, consistent actions can lead to significant changes over time.

2. Create a Supportive Environment

Surround yourself with cues and reminders that reinforce your desired habits. For example, keep healthy snacks readily available, set out your workout clothes the night before, or use habit-tracking apps to monitor your progress. By shaping your environment to align with your goals, you can make it easier to stay on track and resist temptation.

3. Accountability and Social Support

Enlist the support of a friend, family member, or accountability partner who shares your wellness goals. Having someone to hold you accountable can provide motivation, encouragement, and a sense of camaraderie. Whether it's exercising together, meal prepping as a team, or checking in regularly to discuss progress, the mutual support of a trusted ally can make all the difference.

The Power of Community

Building healthy habits is a journey best traveled with others. Having a friend by your side can provide invaluable support, accountability, and motivation. When you join forces with a friend who shares your goals, you can celebrate successes, navigate challenges, and inspire each other to reach new heights. Together, you can overcome obstacles, stay focused on your priorities, and make meaningful progress toward a healthier, happier life.

Here are some statistics and research findings that highlight the benefits of social support, accountability partners, and community involvement in forming new habits:

1. Increased Success Rates: According to a study published in the Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology, individuals who had a support system in place were significantly more likely to achieve their goals compared to those who attempted to go it alone. Having someone to hold you accountable and provide encouragement can enhance your chances of success.

2. Improved Motivation: Research has shown that social support can increase motivation and adherence to behavior change goals. When you have a friend or accountability partner cheering you on, you're more likely to stay committed to your habits, even when faced with challenges or setbacks.

3. Enhanced Well-Being: Studies have demonstrated a positive correlation between social support and overall well-being. Having a strong support network can reduce stress, boost mood, and improve resilience in the face of adversity, all of which are crucial for maintaining healthy habits.

4. Long-Term Sustainability: A study published in the Annals of Behavioral Medicine found that individuals who participated in group-based programs for weight loss and healthy lifestyle changes were more likely to maintain their progress over time compared to those who pursued individual approaches. The camaraderie and sense of community fostered within group settings can help sustain motivation and commitment over the long term.

5. Accountability and Peer Influence: Research conducted by the American Psychological Association suggests that having an accountability partner can lead to greater accountability and adherence to goals. When you know that someone else is counting on you to follow through, you're more likely to stay accountable and resist temptation.

6. Social Connection and Identity: Being part of a community that shares your goals and values can provide a sense of belonging and identity. When you surround yourself with like-minded individuals who are striving for similar outcomes, you're more likely to adopt their habits and behaviors through social influence and modeling.

7. Positive Reinforcement and Encouragement: According to a study published in the Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, receiving positive reinforcement and encouragement from others can increase self-efficacy and belief in one's ability to succeed. When you receive validation and support from your peers, it reinforces your commitment to your goals and boosts your confidence in your ability to achieve them.

These statistics underscore the importance of social support, accountability, and community involvement in the habit-forming process. By leveraging the power of social connections, you can increase your chances of success and enjoy the journey toward achieving your goals even more.

Consider joining a community like THREE and become a brand ambassador. Whether you are seeking personal growth, joining others who are likeminded as you or the chance to make a positive impact, THREE offers the platform and support you need. By joining our brand ambassador program, you can align yourself with a company that values integrity, quality, and social responsibility. Having a support system can provide encouragement, guidance, and a sense of belonging that boosts your chances of success.

Third-party testing involves independent laboratories evaluating and analyzing supplement products to verify their quality, potency, and safety. Join us as we delve into the world of third-party testing and discover how it enhances the integrity and trustworthiness of dietary supplements.

Understanding Third-Party Testing

What is third-party testing?

Third-party testing involves sending supplement products to independent laboratories that are not affiliated with the manufacturer or seller. These laboratories conduct comprehensive analyses and evaluations to assess the quality, purity, potency, and safety of the supplements. The tests are performed by unbiased experts with expertise in areas such as chemistry, microbiology, and quality control.

Third-party testing serves as a crucial quality control measure in the supplement industry. It provides several key benefits, including:

  • Objective assessment: Independent laboratories offer an unbiased evaluation of supplement products, free from any potential conflicts of interest. This ensures an objective assessment of the product's quality and safety.
  • Verification of label claims: Third-party testing verifies the accuracy of the label claims, ensuring that the product contains the stated ingredients in the declared amounts. It helps prevent misleading or inaccurate information about the supplement's composition.
  • Safety assurance: By testing for contaminants, heavy metals, pesticides, and other harmful substances, third-party testing ensures that the supplements are safe for consumption. It helps protect consumers from potential health risks.
  • Quality control: Third-party testing verifies the overall quality of the supplements, including factors such as purity, potency, and efficacy. It helps maintain consistent quality standards across different batches and ensures that consumers receive reliable and effective products.
Assuring quality, safety, and accuracy for consumers

Third-party testing provides consumers with peace of mind and confidence in the supplements they choose. By relying on independent assessments, consumers can trust that the products have undergone rigorous scrutiny and meet high-quality standards. Third-party testing helps protect consumers from misleading claims, potential health hazards, and subpar products.

The Significance of Third-Party Testing for Supplements

Ensuring product efficacy and potency

Third-party testing plays a crucial role in verifying the efficacy and potency of supplements. Through rigorous analysis, independent laboratories assess the concentration and bioavailability of active ingredients. This helps confirm that the supplements are consistent with labeling.

Verification of ingredient authenticity and purity

Third-party testing confirms the authenticity and purity of the ingredients used in supplements. It ensures that the listed ingredients are present in the declared amounts and that no adulteration or substitution has occurred. This verification is essential for maintaining the integrity of the product and safeguarding consumers against fraudulent or low-quality supplements.

Identification of potential contaminants or adulterants

One of the significant benefits of third-party testing is the detection of potential contaminants or adulterants in supplements. Independent laboratories screen for harmful substances such as heavy metals, pesticides, toxins, and microbial contaminants. Identifying and eliminating these contaminants ensures that the supplements are safe for consumption and minimizes the risk of adverse effects.

Building consumer trust and confidence

Third-party testing establishes transparency and builds trust between manufacturers and consumers. By subjecting their products to independent scrutiny, supplement companies demonstrate their commitment to quality, safety, and accuracy. Consumers can have confidence in the supplements they choose, knowing that they have undergone rigorous testing by unbiased experts. This trust is crucial in the supplement industry, where consumers seek products that deliver on their promises and prioritize their well-being.

How Third-Party Testing Benefits Consumers

Empowering consumers to make informed decisions

Third-party testing plays a vital role in empowering consumers to make informed decisions about the supplements they choose to incorporate into their health routines. By providing independent verification of product quality and efficacy, third-party testing arms consumers with the knowledge they need to select supplements that align with their specific health goals.

In an industry where misleading or fraudulent claims can be prevalent, third-party testing serves as a crucial safeguard for consumers. By subjecting supplements to rigorous testing, potential issues such as mislabeling, inaccurate potency claims, or the presence of harmful contaminants can be identified and prevented, ensuring that consumers receive products that are safe and effective.

The implementation of third-party testing promotes transparency and accountability within the supplement industry. By requiring manufacturers to adhere to strict quality standards and undergo independent verification, third-party testing creates a level playing field and encourages responsible practices among supplement companies. This fosters a culture of trust between manufacturers and consumers, leading to a healthier and more reliable marketplace.

title: Clinical Study Results: THREE is Backed by Science
description: Cellular Absorption Study of THREE Products | Discover our cutting-edge formulations and Cellular Absorption Technologies are 3 to 9.5 times more absorbable.
author: Three
html:
At THREE, we're backed by science and what that means is that actual scientists, scholars, and doctors study everything from the plants that make our products, to the rate at which our body absorbs the nutrients within them. We believe that true wellness begins at the cellular level. It's not just about what you consume, but how effectively your body absorbs and utilizes nutrients. That's why we have invested in innovative technologies that enhance absorption and deliver nutrients directly to the cells where they are needed most. Our cutting-edge formulations in all six of our wellness products are designed to ensure optimal bioavailability, allowing your body to fully absorb and benefit from the nutrients.

We wanted to put our products to the test to prove the science behind our formulations. To do this, we put the entire THREE product line through a clinical study to determine the cellular absorption and bioavailability of our products. Our products talk the talk, but do they walk the walk? The results of this study helped us determine at what percentage the nutrients included in the THREE product line being absorbed by the body and well, it’s safe to say we’re pretty excited about the results.

Consider yourself warned, there’s a decent amount of science specific jargon as we publish the study below, we love to nerd out about that stuff over here! If you want to do a TL:DR (too long, didn’t read), you can click the button below to download a summary plus the full study to share with your family and friends and anyone who’s ready to live and feel their best THREE life!

The Purpose of the Study

If a nutritional supplement is to enhance human health, the bioactive ingredients in the product need to cross the cellular membrane at a high concentration to realize this objective.

The problem is this: the bioactive molecules in nutritional supplements are predominantly organic molecules from plants and are hydrophobic (i.e. they are afraid of and are not soluble in water). Because the body is made up of 60% water (the blood is 90% water), these bioactive molecules are poorly absorbed into the cell and have low bioavailability.

General absorption and cellular bioavailability of organic molecules is ~10%.

THREE has developed and employs many different Cellular Absorption Technologies in its products to increase cellular absorption and bioavailability.

The purpose of this clinical study was to determine the cellular absorption and bioavailability of THREE’s product line.

Methods Behind the Study

Cellular absorption and bioavailability was determined by use of a Caco-2 permeability assay using 0.4 μM pore size in a 12-well plate format. Filter was pre-incubated with media for 30 minutes before seeding the cells. 100 μL apical, 600 μL basal. 3X10^5 cells were plated per insert. Media volume was set to 0.5 mL apical and 1.6 mL basal. Media was replaced every 2-3 days until tight junction formation. Products were tested at the concentrations, durations, and then quantified at the absorption ranges shown in Table 1 below.

Results of the Study

Predicted cellular absorption and bioavailability percentages of THREE’s products are shown in Figure 1 below. Actual numbers are as follows: Éternel = 95%, Purifí = 88%, Collagène = 73%, Vitalité = 44%, Imúne = 44%, Revíve = 30%, and curcumin (Organic Control) = 10.

The correct way to analyze the data in Figure 1 is to compare the percent absorption of each product to the organic control, and not between products.

When looked in this way, Revíve, with a cellular absorption percentage of 30, is 3X more bioavailable than curcumin (organic control), which represents a standard organic molecule and served as the control in the experiment. Éternel is 9.5X more bioavailable than curcumin. The significant increases in cellular absorption and bioavailability in THREE’s products versus a standard molecule like curcumin (organic control) is due to the Cellular Absorption Technologies used in THREE’s products that help to shuttle the ingredients in the formulas across the cellular membrane and into the cell at a much higher concentration.

THREE Products are up to 9.5X More Absorbable

A Caco-2 in-vitro cellular absorption assay was used to calculate percent absorption and bioavailability of THREE’s products.

The data found that THREE’s products, due to the Cellular Absorption Technologies used, are between 3 and 9.5 times more absorbable than a standard organic molecule using no delivery technology. Increased cellular absorption and bioavailability should equate to increased product efficacy.

Summary of the Study

The purpose of this clinical study was to determine the cellular absorption and bioavailability of THREE’s product line, meaning, at what percentage are the nutrients included in THREE’s product line being absorbed by the body?

The results of this study indicate that due to the Cellular Absorption Technologies used in formulation and manufacturing, THREE’s products are between 3 and 9.5 times more absorbable than the standard organic control molecule used as a baseline in the study.

Conclusion

Collagen supplementation can help support healthy skin, hair, and nails as well as promoting a healthy immune response and joint function. Our Collagène product is formulated with game-changing ingredients and is highly bioavailable, making it a great choice for those looking to support their health and beauty goals.

By incorporating Collagène into your daily routine, you can help achieve and maintain a healthy, youthful-looking complexion with that coveted dewy glow. The key to proactive wellness is to get started! We invite you to try Collagène today.

title: A Collagen Supplement Unlike the Others
description: Discover the transformative benefits of Collagène by THREE, formulated with game-changing Cynatine, pomegranate extract, vitamin C, and biotin.
author: Three
html:
Collagen is a crucial protein in the body that supports healthy skin, hair, and nails. It is also important for maintaining healthy joint function and supporting a healthy immune response. However, as we age, our bodies produce less collagen, which can lead to visible signs of aging.

This is where collagen supplements come in. Collagen supplements can help support the body's natural collagen production and help support healthy skin, hair and nails. Additionally, select collagen supplements can also support healthy immune function and joint health.

Introducing Collagène by Three

At Three, we have formulated a collagen product called Collagène that is designed to support your overall health and well-being. Our Collagène product takes a holistic approach and is formulated with game-changing Cynatine, pomegranate extract, vitamin C, and biotin to enhance the bioavailability and absorption of collagen.

What sets our collagen supplement apart from standard collagen powders or capsules on the market is our use of hydrolyzed and micronized collagen peptides. Traditional collagen products are often broken down into larger molecules that the body struggles to absorb and utilize. Not so with Collagène. Hydrolyzed and micronized collagen are smaller particles that can more readily cross the intestinal barrier and be transported to skin, joints, and connective tissues, where they are needed the most. 

The Power of Cynatine™

One of the key ingredients in Collagène is Cynatine™, which is a form of keratin that helps promote skin hydration, elasticity, and reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. To break it down even more, collagen provides the structural support that keeps the skin firm and elastic, while keratin reinforces the skin’s surface barrier, resulting in smoother-looking skin. Cynatine, a highly bioavailable form of keratin, helps support hydration and elasticity, giving a smoothing effect. Working together, collagen and keratin nourish your cells from within and provide support against oxidative stress that accelerates aging. They are the perfect beauty-from-within duo tasked to deliver hydration, improve the appearance of elasticity, and improve the appearance of fine lines.

In addition to collagen and keratin, our supplement includes antioxidants and vitamins like pomegranate extract–a potent antioxidant that can help support the body's natural reaction to the effects of free radicals, while vitamin C is essential for collagen synthesis. Biotin is a B vitamin that supports healthy hair, skin, and nails.

In addition to these key ingredients, our Collagène product is also formulated with hydrolyzed and micronized collagen. Hydrolyzed collagen is broken down into smaller peptides that are more easily absorbed by the body, while micronized collagen is finely ground collagen that is more easily dissolved in water.

Why Collagen Matters as We Age

Collagen is the body’s heavy-hitter when it comes to supporting skin elasticity and promoting healthy hair, nails, joints, and connective tissues. Naturally produced collagen begins to decline in your mid-20s, with noticeable physical changes occurring in the 30s and 40s, including the appearance of wrinkles or fine lines, sagging and dry skin, and internal changes such as joint stiffness or slower cell renewal. Because collagen is so central to visible and non-visible signs of aging, high-quality formulas like Collagène can provide a proactive advantage when it comes to  supporting a healthy aging process.

How to Choose the Right Collagen Supplement

When choosing a collagen supplement, it may surprise you to realize that how much collagen a product contains has little to do with its efficacy–or the body’s ability to actually use it. Hydrolyzed collage, also known as collagen peptides, is broken down into smaller chains that are easier for the body to absorb. In addition to the size and bioavailability, the source also matters: marine collagen (from fish) is comprised mainly of type I collagen which is prized for its smaller peptide size and quick absorption, ability to support the health of the skin, bones, tendons, ligaments, and teeth, and it’s skin-focused benefits like appearance of skin firmness, elasticity and the visual reduction of fine lines. In contrast, Bovine collagen (sourced from cows) naturally contains both Type 1 and Type III collagen. Type III collagen is more prevalent in skin, muscles, blood vessels, and internal organs. It contributes to the appearance of skin elasticity and hydration, and helps support the structure of connective tissue.

Regardless of where you source your collagen from, the most important factor is absorption, or in other words, bioavailability. Without good absorption, much of the collagen you consume simply won’t reach the tissues where it’s needed the most.

Beyond collagen absorption, smart and effective collagen formulations include synergistic ingredients that enhance its impact. Vitamin C is essential for collagen synthesis, and antioxidants like pomegranate help support the body's natural reaction to the effects of free radicals, and functional nutrients like keratin (Cynatine™) and biotin further support the health of the skin, hair and nails.

Collagène brings all of these elements together, combining micronized and hydrolyzed collagen with keratin, antioxidants, and vitamins in a portable, great-tasting packet. The result is a supplement that not only delivers the right building blocks, but also makes it easy, and enjoyable, to stay consistent with daily use.

The Ultimate Dewy Skin Cocktail

Taking a collagen supplement like Collagène can help promote the body's natural collagen levels, leading to improved skin appearance. Studies have shown that consuming collagen supplements can lead to increased skin hydration, elasticity, and firmness, as well as a visible reduction in fine lines and wrinkles.

In addition to providing essential amino acids that help with production of collagen in the skin, Collagène also contains game-changing Cynatine, pomegranate extract, vitamin C, and biotin. These ingredients work together to support healthy skin, hair, and nails, making it the ultimate dewy skin cocktail.

A Collagen Supplement That Tastes Great

Collagène is flavored with all-natural strawberry molecules, providing a delicious taste that is easy to enjoy every day. Many collagen supplements fall short because they’re chalky, hard to mix, or inconvenient to consistently take. Collagène solves that problem with portable, on-the-go packets that taste great and blend effortlessly into your routine AND liquids. We understand that busy lifestyles can make it difficult to prioritize self-care, which is why we have made our Collagène product as convenient and easy to use as possible.

More than just easy to use, Collagène delivers a premium formulation: micronized and hydrolyzed collagen for maximum absorption, enhanced with Cynatine™ keratin, antioxidant-rich pomegranate, vitamin C, and biotin. The result is a collagen supplement that’s as enjoyable as it is effective, giving you every reason to take it consistently and see real benefits.

Demand More From Your Collagen

Collagen supplementation can help support healthy skin, hair, and nails as well as promoting a healthy immune response and joint function. But not all collagen is created equal–bioavailability, added nutrients, taste, and convenience can truly set collagen supplements apart. Our Collagène product is formulated with game-changing ingredients and is highly bioavailable, making it a great choice for those looking to support their health and beauty goals.


By incorporating Collagène into your daily routine, you can help achieve and maintain a healthy, youthful-looking complexion with that coveted dewy glow.
