title: Three Proactive Tips to Supporting Foundational Health
description: Rev up your foundational health with three proactive tips for optimal wellness. From balanced diet to exercise and hydration, learn how to be healthier.
author: Admin
html:
Imagine your body as your dream car, the one you've always admired for its sleek design and powerful performance. Just like that extraordinary vehicle, your body's potential is vast, and its performance is deeply intertwined with the maintenance of its foundational components. A well-tuned and well-maintained car not only runs smoothly but can also unleash its full potential. In the same way, nurturing your body's foundational health allows you to rev up your life and harness your full potential.

In the midst of our demanding routines, it's easy to overlook the care our bodies deserve. We often push ourselves to the limit and forget that, much like your dream car, our bodies require meticulous attention and care to perform at their best. The neglect of this vital maintenance can lead to issues that, similar to a neglected dream car, could have been lessened with proper upkeep.

In this blog, we're going to explore three practical tips for building a robust foundation for optimal wellness. These are the equivalent of giving your body the finest fuel, regular oil changes, and tune-ups to keep you going at a strong pace. So, let's dive under the hood and learn how to rev up our foundational health for a smoother ride through life.

Tip 1: Balanced Diet and Nutrient Intake

The foundation of any healthy lifestyle is a balanced diet. Proper nutrition is like the building blocks of your well-being. It's not about restrictive diets or strict rules; it's about nourishing your body with the nutrients it craves. Focus on consuming a variety of whole foods, such as colorful fruits and vegetables, lean proteins, whole grains, and healthy fats. These provide the essential vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants your body requires.



Here’s an example of what a diet in a day could look like to ensure that you get a broad spectrum of nutrients: (While the dietary recommendations provided can be beneficial, it's important to consult a healthcare provider or registered dietitian to ensure that your choices align with your unique health needs and wellness objectives.)

Breakfast

  • Scrambled Eggs with Spinach and Tomatoes: Eggs are an excellent source of high-quality protein. Add spinach and tomatoes for fiber, vitamins, and minerals.
  • Whole-Grain Toast: Choose whole-grain bread for complex carbohydrates and fiber.
  • Avocado Slices: Avocado provides healthy monounsaturated fats.
Morning Snack
  • Greek Yogurt with Berries and Honey: Greek yogurt is rich in protein and probiotics. Berries offer antioxidants and fiber, while honey adds natural sweetness.

Lunch

  • Grilled Chicken Salad: Grilled chicken breast is a lean protein source.
  • Mixed Greens: A variety of leafy greens provides essential vitamins and minerals.
  • Quinoa: Quinoa is a whole grain packed with protein and fiber.
  • Sliced Almonds: Almonds offer healthy fats and crunch.
  • Olive Oil and Balsamic Vinegar Dressing: A simple dressing of olive oil and balsamic vinegar provides healthy fats and flavor.
Afternoon Snack
  • Hummus with Carrot and Cucumber Sticks: Hummus is made from chickpeas, providing protein and fiber.
  • Fresh Veggies: Carrot and cucumber sticks are hydrating and packed with vitamins.

Dinner

  • Baked Salmon: Salmon is a fatty fish rich in omega-3 fatty acids and protein.
  • Steamed Broccoli: Broccoli is a nutritious vegetable packed with vitamins and fiber.
  • Brown Rice: Brown rice offers complex carbohydrates and additional fiber.
Evening Snack (Optional):
  • Sliced Apple with Almond Butter: Apples are a good source of fiber, while almond butter provides healthy fats and protein.

But even with the best intentions, it can be a challenge to get every single nutrient your body needs through diet alone. That's where a top-notch multivitamin like Vitalité by THREE comes into play. It's like the missing piece in your dietary puzzle, ensuring that you don't fall short on crucial nutrients, even on your busiest days.

Tip 2: Regular Exercise and Physical Activity

Another pillar of foundational health is regular exercise. Physical activity supports overall wellness, keeping your heart strong, your muscles and joints functioning optimally, and your energy levels high. It's also a fantastic stress reducer. Aim for at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic activity or 75 minutes of vigorous-intensity exercise each week. Whether it's walking, dancing, swimming, or practicing yoga, find activities you love to make it a sustainable part of your life.

Tip 3: Grab a Water Tumbler

Staying well-hydrated is another practical tip to bolster foundational health. The significance of proper hydration cannot be understated, as it's vital for numerous bodily functions. Water is the elixir of life, and it keeps your systems running smoothly.

When you're well-hydrated, you support your digestion, circulation, and the elimination of toxins. It also helps maintain healthy skin, supports brain function, and keeps your energy levels up. Dehydration, on the other hand, can lead to various health issues, including headaches, sluggishness, and even reduced cognitive function.

To make hydration a habit, carry a reusable water bottle with you throughout the day (insert confetti emoji for proud Stanley owners). Aim to drink at least eight 8-ounce glasses of water daily (64 ounces), but this can vary depending on your body size, activity level, and climate. Adding slices of fresh fruit or herbs to your water can make it more enticing if you find plain water unappealing. Are you getting enough water in a day? Take this quiz to see how much water you need.

By staying hydrated, you're providing your body with a solid foundation to function optimally, and it's a simple yet effective step toward proactive wellness.

Additional Benefits of Taking a Multivitamin like Vitalité

Vitalité is your reliable wellness companion. A daily multivitamin helps you cover many of your nutrient bases, including vitamins, minerals, and other vital components. It bridges nutrient gaps in your diet, helping your body receive the fuel it needs for optimal functioning.

But what makes Vitalité unique is its focus on cellular absorption. With a powerful blend of ingredients, including a Yeast Glycoprotein Matrix, Enzyme Blend, and Polyphenol Complexation, Vitalité enhances the bioavailability of its nutrients. Glycoproteins act like the key that unlocks your cells' doors, ushering in vitamins and minerals. A blend of enzymes breaks down phytonutrients into smaller, absorbable fragments. Polyphenols ease the entry of bioactive molecules into your cells.

Vitalité is your all-in-one wellness support, offering support of heart, brain, and eye health, gut microbiome support, and promoting cellular energy. It's a proactive step your body could benefit from to have a more optimized foundational health.

 

Conclusion

The journey towards optimal wellness starts with a sturdy foundation. By following these three practical tips for balanced diet, regular exercise, and water intake, you're well on your way. And with Vitalité as your partner, you're helping to ensure that your foundation is rock-solid, teeming with vitality, and ready to support a healthier you. Your proactive approach to foundational health will set the stage for better well-being, a journey well worth taking.

NOTE:

While the example daily diet and exercise routine mentioned in this blog can be a valuable reference for many individuals, it's essential to remember that everyone's nutritional needs and fitness levels are unique. Certain dietary choices, such as those containing gluten or dairy, may not be suitable for everyone. Additionally, exercise routines should align with your personal health goals and physical condition.

Before making significant changes to your diet or exercise regimen, we strongly recommend consulting with a qualified healthcare provider or a registered dietitian. They can offer personalized guidance based on your individual health and dietary requirements. This will help ensure that the choices you make are in harmony with your specific needs and wellness goals.
